📰  Why is David Duong accelerating ETH’s push into traditional finance?

Ethereum Institutional has appointed former Coinbase research chief David Duong as its Head of US. A Wall Street veteran with a strong technical background, he has a clear goal: accelerate Ethereum’s institutional adoption in the US. For ETH, this means more traditional financial institutions may bypass crypto’s original players and interact directly with Ethereum’s core ecosystem.

Why does this news matter?

The choice of David Duong reflects the crypto industry’s demand for channels that are “compliant and efficient.” Traditional financial institutions are most concerned about crossing regulatory lines, and Coinbase has already built extensive compliance experience in the US market. With Duong in charge of US operations, Ethereum gains a champion who understands the US financial system—a development more significant than a purely technical breakthrough. It’s like giving crypto projects seeking to enter the US market a guide who knows the terrain and can help them clear compliance hurdles faster.

Market impact

For ETH’s price, this is a typical “sentiment boost” rather than a trend-setting catalyst. ETH is already a popular target for institutional capital, so this news mostly reinforces its “institution-friendly” profile. In the short term, it could attract some higher-risk-tolerance capital and provide a modest tailwind. But in the medium to long term, a genuine breakout in ETH’s price will depend on the scale of actual inflows, not the appointment itself. David Duong 的选择背后，是加密行业对"合规、高效"渠道的渴求。传统金融机构最怕的是踩到监管红线，而 Coinbase 在美国市场已经积累了丰富的合规经验。Duong 负责美国业务，意味着以太坊将获得更懂美国金融体系的推手，这比单纯的技术突破更重要。它像是给想进入美国市场的加密项目，配了个"懂行"的导游，能帮它们更快通过合规关。

Let’s briefly talk about the significance of “time” in investing.

Recently, a lot of people have been in a hurry to talk to me about the markets. This was especially true during the rally around the U.S.-China meeting, when I kept seeing messages asking whether a particular asset was worth adding to a portfolio.

“Time preference” matters a lot in investing. One simple way to distinguish a trader from an investor is by their different time preferences.

100x leverage is about chasing the thrill of a minute; 10x leverage is about chasing the thrill of holding a position for an hour. Without leverage, there’s no thrill. In fact, after achieving major results, many long-term holders feel not so much joy as a delayed sense of joy. Anyone who has waited five years in the investment world for a major payoff probably understands that feeling of waiting for your child to make you proud.

Unless you’re a quantitative trader or a professional trader, don’t follow the market every day. In particular, don’t constantly check your portfolio returns, watch the candlestick charts, or follow the news. The more frequently you check your investments, the more likely short-term fluctuations are to trigger intense emotional swings.

The same goes for people who made gains in this market rally: there’s no need to follow the market every day.

Wealth is hard to accumulate every single moment. You might as well take more breaks and get some rest.

In a few days, it’ll have been exactly a month since I last checked the crypto market. And as far as I’m concerned, the market hasn’t moved much this past month.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in principal and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a 1000U position. If the coin’s price rises 1%, you earn 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note that the loss is calculated based on the total position, including the borrowed funds.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, an adverse move of about 10% in the coin’s price wipes out your principal. This is called liquidation. It doesn’t mean
you only lose everything after a 10% drop; rather, a drop of about 10% wipes you out completely (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, let’s calculate the long-term result: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like a positive expectation. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean -75%, and you need to gain 300% to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of bankruptcy. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out every day in crypto
.

With the same strategy, but only risking 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row mean -18%, which is hardly devastating,
and you still reap the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed; only the position size has—and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

The Lie: The Market Will Bounce Back for Me — The Rescuer Illusion.

Trading Psychology | The Floating Loss Trap.
The Lie: The Market Will Bounce Back for Me — The Rescuer Illusion.

Example: Coins at support levels — ETH / SOL / BNB
ETH support: 2326 USDT | SOL support: 101 USDT | BNB support: 704 USDT
The current price is close to support levels — this is where the illusion begins: "Surely it will bounce back for me."

Real-life example: The rebound illusion — floating loss.
The trader waits for the market to bounce at support to recover the loss, but in reality, the floating loss grows because they hold onto the position without a plan.
• ETH from $2573 to $2326 = -10%, and you say, "It will bounce back."
• SOL from $118 to $101 = -14%, and you wait for a rescuer.
• BNB from $753 to $704 = -6.5%, and you add to your contracts.

Trading psychology:
• Emotional hope instead of a clear plan
• Fear of admitting a mistake
• The "I'll stay in the position if support breaks" strategy is an illusion

Impact:
• The floating loss grows.
• Random, revenge-driven decisions
• Psychological and financial depletion of capital

Practical steps:
1- Set your stop-loss in advance and stick to it — don't move it farther away.
2- Separate emotion from decision-making: follow a plan, not hope.
3- Reduce your position size if support breaks — protect your capital.
4- Review the trade outside the market: Why did you enter? Does the reason still hold?

translatedData.content:
ETH fee proposal refined｜Settlement may use actual bytes｜No chasing trades near $2,400

My stance is to wait and see: neither dress up a development discussion as good news nor rush to buy a rebound just because the price is near a round number. A PR opened in the Ethereum EIPs repository on October 19, #12548, proposes changes to how EIP-8279 calculates the “block access list byte base fee.” The proposal’s author is explicit: during execution, the system conservatively records bytes that might be written, while final settlement looks at the contents actually left in the block access list. For example, if a storage slot is changed and then restored, its key information may still count, but the bytes for the restored value would not be charged as a final addition; balance changes from a reverted call that did not persist should likewise not be treated as final writes. The goal is to limit extreme block sizes while bringing final fees closer to the actual amount of data.

This does not mean “ETH gas fees have already fallen.” The official EIP-8279 page is currently marked Draft, PR #12548  is still Open, and the page says it depends on another change that has yet to be merged. There is no mainnet activation date, nor can a fee reduction for all users be inferred from this page. Why pay attention to it? If the block access list mechanism is adopted in the future, the worst-case volume of bytes nodes must process, the way wallets estimate gas, and the rules for actual post-execution settlement will all need to be coordinated. The clearer the rules, the less likely apps and wallets are to underestimate costs on edge-case transactions. But several steps remain between a draft and client implementation, testnet validation, governance scheduling, and mainnet activation. Short-term spot buying cannot be inferred directly from this text revision.

Consider the market reaction separately. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,399, with a daily open of $2,407.51, an observed low of $2,382.78, and a high of $2,443.70. The price is below the daily open, and $2,400 is the immediate battleground; below, watch $2,383 first, then the rolling low of $2,326. Above, $2,408 is the daily open, and $2,444 is a reference for the range high. Binance previously reported ETH briefly falling below 2,400 USDT, but that was at 14:01 UTC on October 19. Do not treat an old alert as a current quote, or precisely combine USDT and USD prices from different exchanges. There is no evidence that the current weakness was caused by this EIP draft. If the price regains and holds above $2,408, and continues higher, the short-term bearish view would need to be revised. If end-of-day ETF data has not yet been filled in, an automatically displayed 0.0 in a table should not be taken to mean actual net inflows are zero.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit this one out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot position to test a long, capped at 2% of total capital. The entry trigger would be two consecutive 15-minute candles closing above $2,408, followed by a retest of $2,400 that holds, with the current price and order book checked again to confirm there is no significant slippage. First target: $2,425, where I would trim half the position. For the remainder, I would look toward around $2,444; if the price spikes and then falls back below $2,408, I would close the entire position. The stop-loss is a break below $2,382 with confirmation that the price cannot recover. If $2,382 breaks before entry, I would cancel the plan and not add to the position while the price is falling. If the project officially rejects the proposal or market-wide risk changes sharply, reducing risk takes priority. These are all contingency plans, not trades or profits that have already been realized.

Sources: ethereum/EIPs PR #12548, official EIP-8279 draft, Kraken ETH/USD, Farside ETH fund table. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH费用草案再细化｜结算拟看实际字节｜2400美元附近不追单

我的态度是观望，既不把开发讨论包装成利好，也不因价格靠近整数位就抢反弹。以太坊 EIPs 仓库10月19日新开的 PR #12548，拟修改 EIP-8279 的“区块访问列表字节底费”计算。提案作者写得很明确：执行过程中先保守记录可能写入的字节，最终结算时则看交易实际留在区块访问列表里的内容。例如某个存储槽先改后又恢复，钥匙信息仍可能计入，但恢复后的值字节不按最终新增值结算；回滚调用没有留下的余额变化，也不应被当成最终写入。目的是在限制极端区块体积的同时，让最终收费更贴近实际数据量。

这不是“ETH已经降Gas”。EIP-8279 官方页面目前标为 Draft，PR #12548 仍 Open，且说明依赖另一项尚待合并的改动；没有主网激活时间，也没有能从这一页推导出的全体用户手续费降幅。为什么关注它？如果未来区块访问列表机制被采用，节点要处理的最坏情况字节量、钱包估算Gas的方法和执行后实际结算规则都需要协调。规则定义越清楚，应用和钱包越不容易在边缘交易上低估成本。但从草案到客户端实现、测试网验证、治理排期和主网生效之间还有多步，短线现货买盘不能直接由这份文字修订推出。

市场反应单独看。Kraken ETH/USD 写稿约2399美元，日开2407.51美元，可见当日低点2382.78美元、高点2443.70美元。价格在日开之下，2400美元是眼前争夺位；下方先看2383美元，再看滚动低点2326美元；上方2408美元是日开，2444美元是区间高点参考。币安官方此前记录过ETH一度跌破2400 USDT，但那是10月19日14:01 UTC的时点，不可把旧快讯当当前报价，也不可把不同交易所的USDT与USD报价精确混算。现价走弱没有证据表明由这份EIP草案导致；若重新站稳2408美元并延续，短线偏弱判断需要修改。ETF日终数据若尚未填齐，表格自动显示的0.0也不能当作真实净流入为零。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓试多，总资金最多2%。入场触发是价格连续两根15分钟K线收在2408美元上方，随后回踩2400美元不破，同时现价与盘口再次核对无明显滑点。先看2425美元，触及减仓一半；余仓再看2444美元附近，若冲高后重新失守2408美元就全部平仓。止损为跌破2382美元并确认无法收回；若尚未进场就先破2382美元，取消计划，不在下跌途中补仓。若项目正式公告否定方案或全市场风险急变，优先收缩风险。所有条件都是预案，不是已经触发的成交或盈利。

来源：ethereum/EIPs PR #12548、EIP-8279 官方草案、Kraken ETH/USD、Farside ETH基金表。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Just now, Visa and Mesh announced a partnership: soon, the coins in your wallet may be directly spendable at Visa merchants 💳

Put simply, you won’t have to go through the three steps of “sell your crypto, transfer the money to your bank card, then go shopping.”

A few details that are easy to overlook:
🔹 Coverage: Around 175 million Visa acceptance locations worldwide, both online and in person
🔹 No need to get a separate card: The wallet app generates a Visa payment credential in the background, so you can just tap at a regular contactless terminal in-store
🔹 What you can spend: Crypto assets and stablecoin balances
🔹 Who handles the conversion: Mesh converts the crypto to fiat behind the scenes. Merchants receive a regular Visa payment, and don’t need to change anything at checkout
🔹 What’s not yet confirmed: The exact launch date and which wallets will be included in the first rollout haven’t been announced

On the same day, Mastercard, another major card network, also launched “Stablecoin Security,” a tool to help banks detect fraud, scams, and sanctions risks before stablecoin payments go on-chain. It’s launching in North America first, with global availability expected in 2027.

With both major card networks betting on stablecoin payments on the same day, crypto has taken another step toward becoming something people can use for everyday spending.

Here’s the practical question: when it’s actually available, would you use U to buy a coffee—or be too reluctant to spend even a single coin?

title: 交易心理 | 市场情绪周期：从怀疑到狂喜的六幕剧
subTitle:
每一轮行情的剧本几乎一样：
① 怀疑期：涨了几天，没人信，都在喊反弹出货。
② 认同期：创了新高，分析师开始翻多，散户半信半疑上车。
③ 兴奋期：连续拉涨，群里开始晒收益，你开始怕踏空。
④ 狂喜期：朋友圈都在讨论币，出租车司机荐币，杠杆率飙高。
⑤ 否认期：开始下跌，所有人说是「健康回调，上车机会」。
⑥ 恐慌期：连续暴跌，割肉声一片——而下一轮的种子就埋在这里。

对照一下你现在处在哪一幕。赚大钱的机会在①和⑥，亏大钱的位置在
③和④。情绪不可消除，但可以标注：知道自己站在剧本第几幕的人，
不容易把结束当成开始。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone’s calling it a dead-cat bounce and telling people to sell.
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts start turning bullish, and retail investors tentatively get in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge day after day, and everyone is selling at a loss—and this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

A quick chat during the U.S. session—the market has plenty to chew on today.

Physical Brent crude surged to $127, its first time at that level since 2008. A tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, and the U.S. blockaded Iran—energy is the global market’s powder keg right now. The twist: Trump softened his stance on waiving sanctions on Russia, and oil prices immediately gave back their gains. He doesn’t want oil prices to blindside him before the election.

The macro picture is even messier: core CPI came in at 2.6%, hotter than expected, and PPI posted its biggest rise since March 2022. Yet Warsh didn’t endorse an October rate hike, and Polymarket’s odds of one were crushed from 48% to 13%. BofA is still standing by its call for a hike on October 28, but the market clearly isn’t buying it.

$BTC fell just 2.47% last week, holding up much better than the Nasdaq’s 4.43% drop. $ETH was a bit of a laggard, down 4.81%, with ETF outflows for three straight weeks. On the other hand, MSCI wants to kick treasury companies out of its indexes, putting MSTR and its peers under pressure. But Strive still bought the dip in BTC to the tune of over $100 million, while BitMNR added 12,000 ETH. Institutions haven’t stopped buying.

My take: oil prices and inflation are the main forces at play. Before the FOMC decision, $BTC will likely keep grinding sideways and testing our patience. Keep your hands in check and save some powder.

Looking at the moving average system, ETH's current price has fallen below the 7-period moving average (approximately 2,404.20 USDT), the 25-period moving average (approximately 2,407.76 USDT), and the 99-period moving average (approximately 2,421.62 USDT). The MACD indicator is showing a strong bearish signal. The current MACD value is -1.18, the signal line is 2.34, and the MACD histogram is -3.52. The histogram has continued to deepen into negative territory, widening from -1.31 to -3.52, which indicates that bearish momentum is accelerating. The MACD line has crossed below the signal line, forming a death cross—a classic bearish signal.

The RSI (Relative Strength Index) is weak. The 6-period RSI is 36.87, the 12-period RSI is 43.41, and the 24-period RSI is 46.59. The short-term RSI is approaching oversold territory but has not yet entered it. This indicates that a technical rebound is possible in the short term, although the overall trend remains weak.

The KDJ stochastic indicator is showing oversold conditions. The K value is 25.78, the D value is 30.70, and the J value is 15.92. Both the K and D values have entered oversold territory, which typically signals the possibility of a short-term technical rebound. However, it is worth noting that in a weak market, the KDJ indicator may remain in oversold territory for an extended period.

The Bollinger Band width is narrowing, contracting from an initial 108 USDT to approximately 53 USDT. Narrowing Bollinger Bands typically signal an imminent directional breakout. Given that the current price is near the lower band, a break below the lower band at 2,391.87 USDT could trigger an accelerated decline toward around 2,350 USDT.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

On-chain data and capital flows reveal a clear divergence in the Ethereum market. On one hand, institutional adoption continues to accelerate. These persistent ETF outflows are creating significant excess-supply pressure.

Whale selling has also heightened market concerns. A major industry entity has liquidated 80% to 90% of its ETH holdings and shifted into technology stocks. This large-scale capital transfer has dealt a serious blow to market sentiment.

According to technical factor statistics, 8 of 15 quantitative factors are bullish, 6 are bearish, and 1 is neutral, giving bullish factors a share of 53.3%. The composite indicator signal is bearish, with a win rate of 60.87%. This suggests that while medium- to long-term factors are tilted toward optimism, short-term technicals have weakened.

Overall market sentiment is cautious. While adoption by institutions such as JPMorgan provides fundamental support for Ethereum, persistent ETF outflows and whale selling have severely undermined market confidence. title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Deal with a Blockchain’s Fuel Money?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring tokens, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of gas).

【Why is it related to coin prices?】When the market heats up → on-chain transactions surge → gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operations can cost half as much.

ETH Post-Quantum Validator Key Proposal | Watch Around $2,400 First | A Draft Is Not a Mainnet Upgrade

My stance is cautious: I’m willing to follow the long-term security roadmap, but I won’t chase the price just because something is called “post-quantum.” On October 19, a new PR, No. 12550, was opened in Ethereum’s official EIPs repository, titled “Post-Quantum Validator Key Registry.” The submitter proposes registering post-quantum public keys for validators in the Beacon Chain state, with proof of possession required for registration. Existing BLS signing keys could authorize the initial registration, while the withdrawal address could also authorize registration or replacement under the proposed process. The key point is that, under the draft, these new keys would initially remain dormant; they could switch to validator duties only after a future fork. The PR page is currently marked Draft and Open, pending editorial review and consensus. This is not an adopted standard, not a finalized item for this month’s Hoodi testnet, and certainly not evidence that mainnet validators have changed keys today.

Looking at Ethereum’s official post-quantum roadmap as well, the site does list “parallel registration of post-quantum public keys for validators” as one planned milestone, but it also explicitly says that milestones and their order may change. The former is a specific proposal that can be verified today; the latter is an earlier outline of the direction. Taken together, they show only that work on this research path is progressing—not that an upgrade date has been set or that a mainnet vulnerability exploitable by quantum computers has been discovered. The implications for ETH’s mechanics are mainly long term: if validators can eventually register, test, and migrate signing schemes in an orderly way, network security and coordination costs could become more manageable. But implementation would also involve state overhead, client compatibility, cryptographic parameters, and governance decisions. Short-term capital will not automatically flow into ETH because of a repository PR.

Market reactions should be kept separate from engineering progress. Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,400.71 at the time of writing, with a daily open of $2,407.51, a rolling low of $2,326.25, and a high of $2,443.70. The price is near $2,400, not breaking through the high. The individual figures for October 19 in Farside’s US spot ETH ETF table are still incomplete, so its provisional totals should not be presented as a conclusion about that day’s flows. The latest complete figure, for October 16, was a net outflow of $69.7 million. On the price chart, I see around $2,380 as near-term support, $2,400 as the battleground, and around $2,445 as the confirmation level overhead. A bullish view would gain strength only if the price holds above $2,445 on strong volume and then retests it without breaking below. If it falls below $2,380 and continues down toward the $2,330 area, the short-term recovery thesis should be discarded. Neither scenario would justify concluding that the post-quantum proposal caused the price move.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and tentatively wait for confirmation before taking a small spot long position. Major news: The public comment period for the U.S. SEC’s “new token issuance rules” closes on October 20 (U.S. time). Airdrop hunters and project teams alike should take a look 🇺🇸

The proposal is called Regulation Crypto Assets and was introduced in August. Put simply, it would create a clear legal path for “issuing tokens legally in the U.S.”:

🔹 Startup exemption: Raise up to $5 million over four years, with simplified disclosures and no mandatory audit
🔹 Fundraising exemption: Up to $20 million (Tier 1) or $75 million (Tier 2) every 12 months
🔹 Safe harbor: Once a project team completes the core development it committed to, its token may no longer be treated as a security
🔹 Qualifying offerings and some secondary-market transactions would no longer need to be registered state by state

A few easily overlooked details:
1️⃣ The test for determining whether a token is a security still dates back to a 1946 case involving a citrus grove. Over the past decade, many projects have simply issued tokens overseas or excluded U.S. users from airdrops
2️⃣ The Hyperliquid Policy Center submitted a comment letter on October 19 supporting the rules while proposing five changes: explicitly state that “airdrops do not constitute investment contracts”; clarify that steps such as connecting a wallet and passing sanctions screening to claim an airdrop do not count as payment; clarify the rules for secondary-market trading; allow projects to use the safe harbor without first admitting that their tokens were securities; and treat automatic protocol buybacks differently from discretionary buybacks
3️⃣ Some analysts point out that the proposal does not provide an exemption for the brokers and exchanges that actually match trades in these tokens
4️⃣ For now, this is only a proposal. The SEC may still revise it after the comment period ends, and it has not taken effect

What does this mean for ordinary token holders? If the proposal is ultimately adopted, U.S. users may be excluded from airdrops less often, and the requirements for projects to issue tokens compliantly in the U.S. may become much clearer.

Do you think “airdrops are not securities” will make it into the final rules?

重磅：美国 SEC 的「发币新规」10 月 20 日（美国时间）截止公开征求意见，空投党和项目方都值得看一眼🇺🇸

这份提案叫 Regulation Crypto Assets，8 月提出。说白了，就是给“在美国合法发币”开一条正规通道：

🔹 创业豁免：4 年内最多募资 500 万美元，披露从简，不强制审计
🔹 融资豁免：每 12 个月最多 2000 万美元（一档）或 7500 万美元（二档）
🔹 安全港：项目方完成承诺的核心开发后，代币可以不再被当作证券
🔹 符合条件的发行和部分二级交易，不用再逐个州去注册

几个容易被忽略的细节：
1️⃣ 判断代币算不算证券，沿用的还是 1946 年一桩柑橘园案子定下的标准。过去十年，很多项目干脆跑去海外发币，或者空投时直接把美国用户排除在外
2️⃣ Hyperliquid 政策中心 10 月 19 日递交了意见书，支持这套规则，同时提了 5 条修改建议：把“空投不构成投资合同”写进条文；领空投时连接钱包、通过制裁筛查这类手续不算付款；明确二级交易规则；使用安全港时不必先承认代币曾是证券；把协议自动回购和人为回购分开对待
3️⃣ 有分析指出，提案没有给真正撮合这些代币交易的经纪商和交易所留出豁免
4️⃣ 目前仍只是提案，征求意见结束后 SEC 还可能修改，并没有生效

对普通持币人意味着什么？如果最终落地，美国用户被空投“拉黑”的情况可能会变少，项目在美国合规发币的门槛也会清楚很多。

Just two days ago, we said ETF outflows were slowing. Now crypto funds have seen nearly $600 million flow out? Bitmine has gone against the trend again, adding 12,535 ETH. What does this mean?

📰 In its latest announcement, Bitmine Immersion Technologies revealed that it has now purchased a total of 6,041,481 ETH, putting it just one step away from its goal of controlling 5% of Ethereum’s total supply. The company, led by Fundstrat co-founder Tom Lee, continued its weekly accumulation pace over the past week. Its latest purchase has prompted speculation about why it is so firmly betting on Ethereum amid regulatory uncertainty and growing fears about AI’s impact on crypto.

Why does this news matter? First, Bitmine’s accumulation sends a powerful signal in the current market environment. Concerns are mounting that AI is competing for computing resources and could consequently affect the token economics of crypto projects, pushing ETH down from a high of $2,440 to around $2,400. As a leading manufacturer of mining equipment, Bitmine’s continued accumulation signals strong confidence in ETH’s long-term value. This is not simply a financial move; the company’s core business is deeply tied to the health of the ETH ecosystem. If an ongoing outflow of computing power leads to lower ETH mining difficulty and faster token issuance, Bitmine’s profits as an equipment supplier would suffer. Accumulating ETH is therefore both a defensive move and a bet on the industry’s long-term stability.

In terms of market impact, Bitmine’s purchases directly reinforce support for ETH. While 12,535 ETH is modest compared with the hundreds of thousands or even millions of ETH recently moved by whales, its symbolic significance is considerable. It suggests that even as concerns about AI continue to intensify, some institutions still see ETH as attractive at key price levels—around $2,400 at present. This could have a knock-on effect, prompting other institutions or whales holding ETH to lock in profits around these levels to avoid further declines. More broadly, Bitmine’s move could lead regulators to view “deep institutional involvement in the crypto ecosystem” more favorably, indirectly influencing their stance.

💡 If a large-scale migration of computing power causes a sudden surge in ETH supply, Bitmine’s thesis will no longer hold. This means its bullish outlook on ETH depends on the actual scale of AI’s impact on computing power.

title: Ethereum на пороге прорыва? Я бы пока не спешил с выводами
subTitle:
Пока Bitcoin снова пытается удержаться выше важных уровней, Ethereum торгуется примерно в районе $2 420–2 440.
И вокруг ETH сейчас складывается довольно интересная ситуация.
С одной стороны:
🏦 Ethereum уже давно получил доступ к институциональному капиталу через ETF
🔒 огромное количество ETH заблокировано в стейкинге
⚙️ разработчики продолжают масштабировать сеть
📈 любое возвращение интереса к альткоинам может быстро вернуть внимание к ETH
Но есть одна проблема.
Институционалы прямо сейчас не спешат покупать
За неделю, завершившуюся 16 октября, американские spot Ethereum ETF потеряли примерно $320 млн.
Причём около $299 млн оттока пришлось на фонд BlackRock ETHA.
То есть картинка сейчас совсем не такая простая, как:
«BlackRock покупает Ethereum → ETH скоро полетит».
Наоборот — краткосрочно институциональные потоки выглядят довольно слабо.
И именно поэтому ближайшее движение ETH становится особенно интересным.
Где сейчас Ethereum?
ETH находится примерно около $2 400.
Ещё в начале октября цена была выше $2 700, после чего Ethereum достаточно быстро откатился.
Теперь рынок пытается понять:
это просто передышка перед продолжением падения или формирование новой точки для роста?
Я бы сейчас особенно смотрел на диапазон:
🟢 $2 500–2 550 — возвращение выше этой зоны сделает картину заметно интереснее для покупателей
🔴 $2 300–2 400 — потеря этой области может снова усилить давление продавцов
То есть прямо сейчас ETH фактически зажат между двумя сценариями.
Почему Ethereum всё ещё нельзя списывать?
Несмотря на слабые ETF-потоки последних дней, история с институционалами никуда не исчезла.
Всего несколько недель назад Ethereum ETF показывали сильные притоки капитала.
Это говорит о том, что интерес крупных денег к ETH есть — просто он очень чувствителен к состоянию всего рынка.
А Ethereum по-прежнему остаётся инфраструктурой для огромной части:
— DeFi
— стейблкоинов
— токенизации реальных активов
— Layer 2
— NFT
— институциональных блокчейн-продуктов
Поэтому вопрос сейчас скорее не в том, нужен ли рынку Ethereum, а в том, по какой цене инвесторы снова захотят активно его покупать.
И вот тут начинается самое интересное
Представим два сценария.
🚀 Сценарий №1
Ethereum возвращается выше $2 500–2 550, ETF-потоки снова становятся положительными, а Bitcoin продолжает восстановление.
Тогда разговор о движении к $2 700+ становится гораздо серьёзнее.
🩸 Сценарий №2
ETH не может вернуть $2 500, институциональные оттоки продолжаются, а весь рынок снова начинает снижаться.
Тогда тест области $2 300 уже не будет выглядеть чем-то невозможным.
Поэтому лично я сейчас не покупал бы Ethereum только из-за фразы:
«ETH сильно упал, значит он дешёвый».
Падение цены само по себе ещё не делает актив выгодной покупкой.
Намного интереснее дождаться момента, когда вместе с ценой начнут возвращаться спрос и капитал.
👇 А вы что выберете для ETH первым?
🚀 $2 700
или
🩸 $2 300
Пишите только одну цифру — потом проверим, кто оказался прав.

Simply put, the Middle East is a key region for the crypto market, and Google tightening its ad rules is effectively setting ground rules for the industry. This is in line with the UAE’s previous efforts to foster orderly development of its crypto market. Why the sudden tightening? Perhaps Google found too many misleading ads, or it wants to align with EU standards.

As for the market impact, Bitcoin and Ethereum could see short-term volatility driven by sentiment. Why? When news of tighter regulation breaks, investors are bound to think twice. title: Lighter launches BTC and ETH binary options on Core
subTitle:
Lighter, the Ethereum zk-rollup exchange best known for perpetual futures, has added a simpler product to its menu: binary options on Bitcoin and Ethereum.
The feature went live on Lighter Core on October 19, 2026. It is a notable departure for a platform whose identity has been built on leveraged perpetual contracts.
The new contracts are structured as Up/Down markets. Traders take a view on whether BTC or ETH will move higher or lower.
Each winning share pays out 1 USDC. A losing share, by the nature of a binary contract, pays nothing.
Every position must be fully funded in USDC before it opens. That single design choice removes leverage from the equation entirely.
No leverage also means no liquidations. The most you can lose is what you paid for the share.Trading runs on an order-book model, the same matching structure that underpins Lighter's existing markets. Buyers and sellers post bids and asks, and prices are set by where they meet rather than by a formula.
The rollout did not appear out of nowhere. Around September 20-21, 2026, Lighter pushed a codebase update that added ZK circuit support for binary outcome contracts and scalar payouts.
That update came through a change to the platform's zero-knowledge prover. The prover is the component that generates cryptographic proofs that trades were executed correctly, which are then verified on Ethereum.
Lighter describes itself as an app-specific zk-rollup built to optimize exchange workloads. The goal is trading speed comparable to a centralized exchange, while keeping activity verifiable on-chain and leaving users in custody of their funds through Ethereum settlement.
The exchange's public mainnet launched in October 2025. That makes the binary options debut land almost exactly one year after Lighter opened its doors to the public.
Binary options are also framed as a first step rather than the finish line. Lighter plans to eventually introduce full vanilla options.
The move also nudges Lighter toward territory occupied by prediction markets such as Polymarket. Both rely on fully funded shares that resolve to a fixed payout, and both let market prices act as a running probability estimate. Lighter's initial offering is confined to the direction of two crypto assets, while Polymarket covers a wide range of event outcomes.
The LIT token saw modest price fluctuations that tracked earlier news about the binary options feature, reflecting market interest in the platform's evolution.#lighter #BTC走势分析 #eth $BTC

title: Ethereum Sets October 26 Hoodi Test For Glamsterdam Upgrade As 200M Gas Limit Nears
subTitle:
Ethereum’s next major upgrade has another date on the calendar, though it is not a mainnet launch. Developers have scheduled Glamsterdam to activate on the Hoodi test network on October 26, a further step in testing changes to how Ethereum produces blocks and accounts for execution costs.
 Glamsterdam is scheduled for Hoodi at 17:42:48 UTC on October 26. The testnet‘s gas limit will rise to 200 million at the same point, but Ethereum has not announced a mainnet activation date.
The Ethereum Foundation says the upgrade will activate at Hoodi epoch 132,352, slot 4,235,264. It follows the upgrade’s October 6 activation on Sepolia, giving developers another environment to check software compatibility before choosing a date for the main chain.

Two changes sit at the heart of Glamsterdam. Enshrined proposer-builder separation, or ePBS, moves the relationship between block proposers and builders into Ethereum’s protocol instead of relying as heavily on outside arrangements. Block-level access lists are intended to make it easier for clients to process and validate parts of a block in parallel.
The upgrade also changes gas accounting, including how Ethereum charges for state creation and access. That matters to application developers whose contracts or tools rely on fixed assumptions about gas costs. Validators and node operators on Hoodi, meanwhile, will need compatible execution and consensus clients before the activation.
A 200-million gas limit on a test network is an important engineering milelstone, not a promise that mainnet capacity will instantly quadruple. The Hoodi exercise will help determine whether the planned changes behave as expected under real operating conditions. Mainnet users have no action to take yet.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is a Position Too—and the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat.
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying flat after a few consecutive bad trades—the money you save in these three situations,
is more than most trades earn.

You may be tired of hearing the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just one second. If you have capital on hand, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your ammunition.

一、以太坊价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千四百零一美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之一点一九。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内呈现窄幅震荡格局。价格从二千四百二十九美元的高位回落至二千三百八十五美元的日内低点，随后在二千四百美元附近反复整理。最近一个小时的成交额仅为一百五十四万美元，较此前数小时大幅缩量，显示市场处于周末低波动状态。

值得关注的是，以太坊在本周末同样经历了山寨币普跌的冲击。但由于机构层面的持续利好消息，ETH的跌幅相对有限。价格从二十四小时低点二千三百三十八美元反弹至二千四百三十八美元阻力位附近后回落，目前在二千四百美元整数关口附近寻求支撑。

二、技术指标深度解读

均线系统方面，七日均线报二千四百零七美元，二十五日均线报二千四百零六美元，九十九日均线报二千四百二十二美元。短期均线几乎重合且位于九十九日均线下方，价格运行在所有均线下方，表明短中期趋势偏弱。特别值得注意的是，九十九日均线对价格形成了明显的压制作用。

MACD指标显示，DIFF线报零点零九六，DEA线报三点二八九，柱状图为负三点一九。MACD柱状图连续为负且仍在扩大，空头动能持续释放。DIFF线已经接近零轴，若继续下行将确认中期空头趋势。

RSI方面，六周期RSI报四十点二六，十二周期RSI报四十五点三四，二十四周期RSI报四十七点六二。各周期RSI均处于中性偏弱区域，尚未进入超卖区间，意味着下行空间可能仍然存在。KDJ指标中K值报二十八点七，D值报三十点二，J值报十八点三，三线处于偏低位置但未达到极端超卖水平。

布林带上轨报二千四百四十五美元，中轨报二千四百一十八美元，下轨报二千三百九十二美元。价格目前在中轨和下轨之间运行，布林带开口有收窄趋势，暗示变盘可能即将到来。ATR指标报十八点零五，波动率较低。SAR指标报二千四百三十八美元，位于价格上方，维持空头信号。

综合因子统计显示，十五个交易因子中有十个发出做空信号，仅四个发出做多信号，空头占比高达百分之六十六点七。复合指标给出明确的做空信号，数值为负一点三二。这表明短期内以太坊面临的下行压力较大。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

从基本面来看，以太坊近期获得了重要的机构利好。摩根大通旗下区块链部门Kinexys将其美元存款代币JPM Coin正式部署到以太坊主网，实现了全天候近实时的机构间点对点转账。JPMD现在同时支持Base和以太坊两个网络，扩大了大型客户的链上支付选项。这一举措标志着传统金融机构对以太坊基础设施的信任进一步增强。

然而资金面并不乐观。美国现货以太坊ETF上周净流出约三点二亿美元，已连续三周出现净流出。这一持续的机构卖盘压力对价格形成了明显压制。同时，验证者退出队列正在接近进入队列的水平，暗示网络质押锁仓可能降温。

从链上数据来看，Bitmine Immersion累计增持了一万二千五百三十五枚ETH，价值约三千万美元，为企业级需求提供了支撑。德国Sparkassen银行同样为以太坊现货交易提供了零售渠道。综合来看，以太坊正处于机构利好与ETF资金外流的博弈之中，短期内价格可能在二千三百五十至二千四百五十美元区间内震荡整理。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own decisions. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in execution), and
what you'll do differently next time (a specific action). Keep it up for a month, and you'll be amazed to discover that your losses
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, immediately reversing direction after getting stopped out,
or repeatedly failing to let winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just check your account balance—look through your trade records.

Big news: Germany’s savings banks (Sparkassen) have put Bitcoin directly into their mobile banking app 🇩🇪

Starting October 19, the first five savings banks have enabled crypto trading in the Sparkasse app. The service is called “Krypto – powered by Deka” and is operated by DekaBank, the group’s securities institution.

A few easy-to-miss details:
🔹 Coins available: BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, POL (Polygon)
🔹 Fees: €0.99 per transaction, plus the buy/sell spread
🔹 Getting started: No need to open a separate securities account. Just open a Deka crypto account in the app’s investments section. Adults only; no investment advice is provided.
🔹 Rollout: There’s no nationwide launch date; each savings bank decides for itself. Another 30–40 will be added each month, with the goal of reaching most interested banks in the first half of 2027. More than 230 have already expressed interest.
🔹 Custody: The coins are held by DekaBank together with Börse Stuttgart. You don’t hold the private keys. For now, you can’t withdraw directly to your own hardware wallet; you can only transfer to addresses belonging to designated crypto service providers.
🔹 Risks: The German Savings Banks Association classifies crypto assets as “highly speculative,” warns that you could lose everything, and notes that they are not covered by statutory deposit insurance.

Put simply: In the future, tens of millions of German savers will be able to buy Bitcoin as easily as they buy funds in their banking app. The trade-off is that the coins stay with the bank—you can’t hold them yourself, at least for now.

What’s more interesting is that about four years ago, this banking group was still opposed to offering crypto services. It says the shift is driven by customer demand, along with the reliable legal framework provided by the EU’s MiCA regulation. N26, Trade Republic, Revolut, and partner banks have offered similar services for a while, so competition has also pushed the savings banks to make this move.

Meanwhile, the Russian central bank is setting deadlines for transactions involving self-custody wallets. “Who actually holds the private keys?” is becoming a question ordinary people can’t avoid before buying crypto.

If your banking app let you buy BTC with one tap but wouldn’t let you withdraw it to your own wallet, would you use it?

重磅：德国储蓄银行（Sparkassen）把比特币直接放进了手机银行 App🇩🇪

10 月 19 日起，首批 5 家储蓄银行在 Sparkasse App 里开通了加密交易，服务名叫「Krypto – powered by Deka」，由集团旗下的证券机构 DekaBank 来运营。

几个容易被忽略的细节：
🔹 能买的币：BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL、POL（Polygon）
🔹 费用：每笔 0.99 欧元，另外还有买卖价差
🔹 门槛：不用另开证券账户，在 App 投资板块里开一个 Deka 加密账户就行，仅限成年人，不提供投资建议
🔹 节奏：没有全国统一上线日，由每家储蓄银行自己决定；之后每月新增 30–40 家，目标是 2027 年上半年覆盖大部分有意向的银行，目前表达兴趣的已超过 230 家
🔹 托管：币由 DekaBank 联合斯图加特证券交易所保管，私钥不在你手里；目前不能直接提到自己的硬件钱包，只能转到指定加密服务商的地址
🔹 风险：德国储蓄银行协会把加密资产定性为「高度投机」，提醒可能全部亏损，也不受法定存款保险保护

说白了：几千万德国储户以后买比特币，会像在银行 App 里买基金一样顺手。代价是币放在银行那里，想自己保管暂时做不到。

更有意思的是，大约四年前这个银行集团还不主张做加密业务。这次转向给出的理由是客户需求，加上欧盟 MiCA 提供了可靠的法律框架。N26、Trade Republic、Revolut 和合作银行早就有类似服务，储蓄银行这一步也是被竞争推着走。

这两天俄罗斯央行也在给自托管钱包交易定期限，「私钥到底在谁手里」正在变成普通人买币前绕不开的问题。

如果你的银行 App 能一键买 BTC，但不能提到自己的钱包，你会用吗？

ETH briefly fell below $2,400 | ETF flows for today are still pending | My choice is to wait for a reclaim before acting

My stance is to play defense: I won’t treat a single move through a round-number level as the start of a sustained decline, or rush to buy the dip just because prices bounce a few dollars. According to market data recorded by Binance’s official news account, ETH briefly fell below 2,400 USDT at 14:01 UTC on October 19, trading at around 2,392.86 USDT. That is the event behind the current #ETHDropsBelow2400USDT topic on Binance Square. It refers to a specific time and trading pair; it doesn’t mean ETH stayed below 2,400 every minute afterward, nor is it an announcement of a problem with the Ethereum network. As I prepared this article, I also checked ETH/USD on Kraken: the latest trade was around $2,400.16, against an opening price of about $2,407.51, with an intraday low of roughly $2,382.78 and a high of around $2,443.70. The platforms and quote currencies differ, so a later snapshot in dollars cannot be used to “correct” an earlier news item quoted in USDT.

Why should traders care? Around $2,400 is a psychological level the market is watching closely. A break below it can bring short-term stop-losses and forced deleveraging into play, while a move back above it can attract momentum buyers. But these are only possible price dynamics; we can’t conclude that a single piece of news caused the dip. Fund-flow data also needs to be treated within its proper time frame: in Farside’s spot ETH ETF flow table, the row for October 19 is not yet complete. The latest full-day figure, for October 16, showed net outflows of about $69.7 million. Outflows from an earlier trading day point to weaker institutional demand in the preceding period; they should not be presented as today’s net flows after the close. The Ethereum Foundation’s October 16 announcement concerned activation of the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet on October 26. The mainnet date has not yet been set, and this is not direct evidence explaining the move below $2,400.

The market has given us a useful but incomplete signal: Kraken’s price has rebounded from around $2,380 intraday to near $2,400, but it is still below the open, with no confirmation of a sustained hold above that level. I’d treat $2,380–$2,390 as short-term support, $2,420 as the first hurdle for a stronger rebound, and around $2,444 as resistance near the day’s high. A sustained move back below $2,380 would invalidate the rebound thesis; a high-volume hold above $2,444 would mean my cautious view should give way to actual buying pressure. “High volume” here should be confirmed by sustained trading and closes on the same exchange, not by piecing together screenshots from different platforms.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now and consider only a spot long, with a maximum position size of 2% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger would be two consecutive one-hour candles closing above $2,420, followed by a retest that holds above $2,405. I’d then enter in two equal tranches of 1% each. The first target would be $2,444, where I’d take half off; the second target would be $2,480, with a trailing stop on the remainder. If a one-hour candle closes below $2,380 after entry, I’d exit the entire position at a loss. I’d also exit early if the move proves to be a false breakout and price falls back below $2,400 within two hours. If price first breaks decisively below $2,380, I’d cancel the long setup and keep my funds in cash while waiting for a new structure to form. This is only a conditional plan; if the triggers aren’t met, there is no trade or profit.

Sources: Binance Official News, Farside ETH ETF table, Ethereum Foundation announcement, Kraken market data. #ETHDropsBelow2400USDT #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every bit of good advice. So I wrote mine down and stuck it up where I could see it:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never let a single trade lose more than 2% of your capital. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s it—just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

📰 Just said U.S. bank tokens were expanding onto Ethereum—and now the door to tokenization is wide open

I just talked about this a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. JPMorgan’s integration of Ethereum could mean that crypto tokenization is no longer a game reserved for Wall Street giants. According to CryptoBriefing, Brickken’s CEO says this could help smaller banks get involved, improve the flow of capital, and give ordinary people access to more financial services. In short: the blockchain arms race in banking is heating up—but this time, it’s more inclusive.

Why is this news important? The main reason is that crypto tokenization has previously been reserved for high-net-worth players, while banks have been reluctant to get involved because of technical barriers and regulatory concerns. JPMorgan is signaling that the stronger Ethereum’s smart-contract capabilities become, the more easily banks can innovate in finance at lower cost. What does this mean? Bank-affiliated capital is beginning to explore crypto on a large scale—but this time, rather than buying coins directly, it’s using technology to support the real economy. The recent increase in activity on the BNB Chain may be banks getting some practice in.

What’s the market impact? In the short term, ETH sentiment could get a boost, but the impact on Bitcoin could be more far-reaching. Around $2.4K is a key level for ETH. If banks really can use ETH as a foundation, its price could potentially surge to $2.6K. But keep in mind that this is an indirect effect. U.S. banking regulations remain strict, and JPMorgan’s move is only a pilot; widespread adoption is at least a year away. For Bitcoin, this kind of bank-led, technology-focused partnership is more like an endorsement of the long-term trend, and resistance above $80K could weaken.

💡 ETH could see a wave of tech-driven speculation, but BTC is the main beneficiary. This view would no longer hold if the U.S. passed legislation requiring banks to use crypto tokenization technology.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their wealth in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year; steadily earning 10% a month,
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one remarkable feature—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You can wait for the market, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market;
the ability you build toward the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

Core method for identifying sentiment turning points in the crypto market to avoid liquidation:

These are the high-risk junctures most likely to trigger futures liquidation. When the following 3 types of signals converge, it basically confirms that a top is forming:

1. Market signals: The market’s maximum consecutive limit-up streak keeps shrinking; high-flying coins break their streak and then plunge repeatedly; coins that broadly rose the previous day gap down at the open en masse and fail to hold their limit-up levels; the number of coins hitting limit-up prices drops sharply, while the number hitting limit-down prices or plunging surges. Trading volume expands abnormally at elevated levels.
2. On-chain signals: Bitcoin and major-coin balances on exchanges rise rapidly, suggesting that many users are transferring coins to exchanges to prepare to sell. The share of holdings held by long-term investors keeps falling, while smart money takes profits en masse.
3. Sentiment signals: FOMO across the internet is at a fever pitch. Social media is full of comments like “coin prices are about to hit new highs” and “go all in and achieve financial freedom.” Even acquaintances who have never paid attention to crypto are starting to ask how to get in.

Identifying a bottoming sentiment turn (to avoid panic selling)
Many people panic-sell at the very bottom late in a downturn and miss the subsequent rebound. Here are the signals to look for:

4. Market signals: After several major coins plunge in tandem, trading volume contracts rapidly. Selling pressure has been fully exhausted, with no fresh wave of panic selling. Although the rebound may be brief, the wealth-destroying effect is no longer spreading.
5. On-chain signals: Stablecoin balances on exchanges keep rising, suggesting that sidelined capital is building up in preparation to enter the market. Whale addresses accumulate for several consecutive days, and the number of new addresses holding coins grows steadily. #ETH

The rate-hike trade is back, and $BTC  is holding up better than the Nasdaq.

September core CPI came in at 2.6%, above expectations, while PPI was even more dramatic, posting its biggest monthly gain since March 2022. The root cause is still the Middle East: an oil tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, sending Brent spot prices soaring to $127, a post-2008 financial-crisis high. If oil prices don’t come down, inflation isn’t going away.

The odds of a rate hike in October have been on a roller coaster: Polymarket odds surged from 22% to 48%, then fell back to 13% after Waller refused to budge. The Fed is in its blackout period ahead of the October 28 decision, so the market can only guess.

This week, $BTC fell just 2.47%, while the Nasdaq dropped 4.43%. $ETH, meanwhile, fell 4.81%—even worse than the Nasdaq. Fund flows are also pulling in opposite directions: ETH ETFs have seen $1 billion in outflows over three weeks, but BitMine keeps buying, bringing its holdings to 6.04 million ETH, nearly 5% of the supply. Strive also just spent $100 million to scoop up 1,223 BTC.

Keep an eye on two things next: first, MSCI’s final list on November 11. $MSTR and Metaplanet could be dropped from the index, forcing passive funds to sell; second, the October 28 FOMC meeting. The good news is that institutional infrastructure is still moving forward: JPM Coin just went live on Ethereum mainnet, and Deutsche Bank’s custody service is only weeks away.

The short-term outlook faces macro headwinds, but the long-term story isn’t over.

title: JPMorgan идёт в Ethereum: зачем банковскому гиганту собственный токен?
subTitle:
Пока крипторынок ищет следующую монету с ростом ×10, крупнейший банк США расширяет использование блокчейна для долларовых расчётов.
19 октября стало известно о выходе JPM Coin на Ethereum для институциональных клиентов. Что стоит за этой новостью — и какое отношение она имеет к ETH?
🪙 Что такое JPM Coin?
Это цифровое представление долларового депозита в JPMorgan. Тикер — JPMD.
Его задача — помогать одобренным клиентам банка переводить деньги и проводить расчёты в блокчейне. Это не новая монета, которую банк выпустил для заработка розничных трейдеров.
Публичная сеть здесь не означает свободный доступ для всех: участники по-прежнему проходят банковскую проверку.
⚡ Зачем это банку?
Бизнесу нужны платежи за пределами рабочего дня и расчёты с активами, которые уже существуют в блокчейне.
Например, если ценные бумаги представлены токенами, для сделки удобно иметь денежный инструмент в той же цифровой среде. JPM Coin предназначен в том числе для платежей, расчётов и внесения обеспечения.
🌐 Почему именно Ethereum?
По сообщению Bloomberg, банк объясняет выбор ликвидностью сети и тем, что ею уже пользуются его клиенты.
При этом JPMorgan не начинает с нуля: ещё в ноябре 2025 года JPM Coin стал доступен на Base — сети второго уровня Ethereum. Теперь речь о расширении на основную сеть.
📈 Значит, ETH обязательно вырастет?
Автоматически — нет.
Использование Ethereum крупным банком усиливает аргумент в пользу практической востребованности сети. Но запуск продукта сам по себе не показывает, сколько операций он принесёт и насколько повлияет на спрос на ETH.
Доллары, представленные токенами в сети, — не то же самое, что доллары, потраченные на покупку эфира.
👀 За чем следить дальше?
За реальным использованием: сколько клиентов подключится, какие объёмы расчётов появятся и какие активы будут обслуживаться.
Мой вывод: интереснее всего здесь то, что банк использует публичный блокчейн для конкретной финансовой задачи. А оценивать масштаб этой истории стоит по работе продукта после запуска.
Для вас это сильная новость для Ethereum — или рынок слишком рано радуется приходу банков?

The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $2,457.73, a middle band at $2,415.04, and a lower band at $2,372.36. The current price is slightly above the middle band, in the upper half of the Bollinger Band range. The bands are narrowing overall, with the upper band tightening from $2,467 to $2,458. Although the MACD histogram is negative, the magnitude of the negative reading has been gradually narrowing: it widened from -0.63 to -1.31, then narrowed to -2.02, where it showed signs of stabilizing. The Williams indicator is -64.59, also in relatively weak territory. The ATR is 18.59, indicating a slight increase in volatility.

III. Market Sentiment and Fundamental Analysis

Ethereum has recently received a significant institutional boost. Kinexys, JPMorgan Chase’s blockchain division, has expanded its dollar deposit token, JPM Coin, to the Ethereum mainnet. Previously, the token operated only on Coinbase’s Base Layer 2 network. This move means Ethereum is becoming an important infrastructure for traditional financial institutions to settle on-chain assets and manage collateral, providing substantive support for Ethereum’s long-term value.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

二零二六年十月十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千四百零六点八一美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之一点三。从小时K线数据来看，以太坊在过去五个交易时段内呈现先跌后涨再回落的走势。价格从二千四百二十六美元开盘，经历了一波下探至二千三百八十五美元的日内低点后，迅速反弹至二千四百二十四美元，随后再次小幅回落至二千四百零六美元附近。整体波动区间约四十美元，振幅相对温和。

从均线系统来看，七小时均线报二千四百一十八美元，当前价格略低于短期均线。二十五小时均线位于二千四百零五美元，九十九小时均线在二千四百二十二美元。值得注意的是，短中长期均线高度粘合，价格围绕均线密集区波动，这是典型的蓄势整理形态，预示着后续可能出现较大幅度的方向性突破。

二、技术指标深度解读

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千四百五十七点七三美元，中轨在二千四百一十五点零四美元，下轨在二千三百七十二点三六美元。当前价格略高于中轨，处于布林带中间偏上的位置。布林带整体呈收窄态势，带宽从上轨二千四百六十七美元收窄至二千四百五十八美元，表明市场正在积蓄能量，变盘窗口即将打开。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为三点零六，DEA线为五点零七，MACD柱状图为负二点零二。虽然MACD柱状图为负值，但负值幅度在逐步收窄，从负零点六三扩大至负一点三一再收窄至负二点零二后出现企稳迹象。DIF线与DEA线之间的距离在缩小，若后续DIF线上穿DEA线形成金叉，将释放短期看多信号。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报三十八点一五，已进入偏弱区域。十二周期RSI报四十六点零四，二十四周期RSI报四十八点三四。与比特币类似，以太坊的短周期RSI偏弱但中长周期仍处于中性区间。KDJ指标中K值为三十五点九八，D值为四十二点七零，J值为二十二点五四，三线均处于中低位，短期存在超跌反弹的技术需求。

威廉指标报负六十四点五九，同样处于偏弱区域。ATR指标报十八点五九，波动率略有上升。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

以太坊近期迎来了重要的机构利好。摩根大通旗下区块链部门Kinexys将其美元存款代币JPM Coin扩展至以太坊主网，此前该代币仅在Coinbase的Base二层网络上运行。这一举措意味着以太坊正在成为传统金融机构进行链上资产结算和抵押品管理的重要基础设施，对以太坊的长期价值构成实质性利好。

然而，以太坊现货ETF连续第三周录得净流出，上周流出规模达三点二亿美元，甚至超过了比特币ETF的二点二九亿美元流出量。这反映出部分机构投资者在短期内对以太坊持谨慎态度。此外，稳定币结算领域面临竞争压力，TRON网络占据约百分之七十三的USDT市场份额，而以太坊仅占百分之十五，这在一定程度上限制了以太坊的手续费收入增长潜力。

从链上数据来看，Bitmine公司新增了约一万二千五百三十五枚以太坊持仓，显示机构对以太坊的中长期信心依然存在。欧洲方面，MiCA框架下约四千二百万零售客户可通过储蓄银行网络交易以太坊相关资产，进一步扩大了用户覆盖面。

综合来看，以太坊当前处于技术面蓄势阶段，均线密集粘合暗示变盘临近。摩根大通JPM Coin上链为中长期基本面提供了有力支撑，但短期ETF资金流出构成压力。建议投资者关注二千三百七十美元的布林带下轨支撑和二千四百六十美元的布林带上轨阻力，等待突破方向明确后布局。

title: 4 Ways to Thrive in a Ranging or Volatile Market While Others Are Losing
subTitle:
The market doesn't have to trend for you to make progress. You just need to know what environment you're trading.
One of the biggest mistakes traders make is believing that their strategy should work in every market condition.
It won't.
A strategy that performs exceptionally well in a strong trend can become a losing strategy when the market starts ranging. Likewise, a trader who understands volatility can find opportunities where others are getting stopped out repeatedly.
The goal isn't to predict every move.
The goal is to adapt.
Here are 4 ways to survive—and potentially thrive—when the market becomes difficult.
1. Stop Forcing Trend-Following Setups in a Range
This is where many traders get destroyed.
The market moves up → you look for a long.
The market pulls back → you look for another long.
Then it reverses.
You short.
It reverses again.
Before you know it, you've taken five trades and the market has gone almost nowhere.
A ranging market doesn't reward blindly following trends because there may be no meaningful trend to follow.
Instead, identify whether price is trapped between clear support and resistance.
If the market repeatedly rejects the same upper and lower zones, treat the environment differently.
Don't trade the market you wish you had. Trade the market that's actually in front of you.
2. Reduce Your Position Size and Leverage
Volatility isn't automatically bad.
Uncontrolled exposure is.
When the market starts moving violently, your normal position size can suddenly become too large.
A move that would normally be considered a small fluctuation can hit your stop-loss almost immediately.
This is where risk management becomes more important than your entry.
Consider reducing:
- Position size
- Leverage
- Number of trades
- Risk per trade
You don't need to make your biggest profits during chaotic conditions.
Sometimes the smartest trade is simply protecting your capital until the market becomes clearer.
> Your first responsibility as a trader isn't making money. It's staying in the game long enough to make money consistently.
3. Trade the Reaction, Not the Emotion
Volatile markets create something extremely dangerous:
FOMO.
Bitcoin suddenly moves 3%.
Everyone starts screaming:
> "LONG!"
You enter late.
Then the market reverses.
You panic and close.
Then it moves back in your original direction.
This cycle can continue until your account is destroyed—not because your analysis was terrible, but because your decisions were emotional.
Instead of chasing large candles, wait for the market to show you what it's actually doing.
Look for:
Impulse → Pullback → Confirmation → Entry
Rather than:
Impulse → FOMO → Entry → Panic
The bigger the move, the more important patience becomes.
4. Know When NOT to Trade
This may be the most profitable skill of all.
You don't have to trade every day.
You don't have to trade every setup.
And you definitely don't have to recover today's losses today.
If your strategy performs poorly in a particular environment, sitting out is a valid trading decision.
Professional traders don't make money simply by finding more trades.
They make money by becoming extremely selective about which trades deserve their risk.
Sometimes the best position is:
NO POSITION.
Wait for the market to return to conditions where your strategy has an actual edge.
The Real Secret: Adaptation
There is no single strategy that dominates every market condition.
Trending market?
Adapt.
Ranging market?
Adapt.
High volatility?
Adapt.
Low volatility?
Adapt.
The traders who survive for years aren't necessarily the people who predict the market perfectly.
They're the people who understand:
"This is the type of market I'm dealing with—and this is how I should behave in it."
Don't try to conquer every market. Learn to recognize which battles are worth fighting.
Trade smart. Protect your capital. Stay patient.
— Cryptobozz Academy

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candlestick you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin shoots up in a huge bullish candle, everyone in the group is shouting “Buy!”, and you nervously jump in—only to end up
buying at the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a good look at that huge bullish candle that made your heart race: it’s the one people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase, so they can unload
After a sharp rally on heavy volume, chasing the price is essentially providing liquidity to those who were already holding.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and the price stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you a second stake.

📰 Is large-scale business adoption of stablecoins worth it? Payoneer survey: 90% say yes

A Payoneer survey found that 90% of businesses using stablecoins believe they’re worth the effort. This reflects the growing use of stablecoins in commerce, with the potential to transform areas such as cross-border payments and supply chain finance. For everyday investors, this means more businesses are recognizing the practical value of stablecoins, and demand may increase further in the future.

Why is this news important?
This survey shows that stablecoins are shifting from speculative hype toward practical applications. Businesses tend to focus more on efficiency and cost control than individual investors do. They may choose stablecoins because they can help avoid traditional currency exchange-rate fluctuations and fees in cross-border transactions. This reflects business demand for low-cost, fast international payments—a need that stablecoins can partly meet. It also means stablecoins are gradually building an economic foundation of their own, rather than serving merely as financial derivatives.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could boost sentiment toward stablecoin-related tokens. Although stablecoins themselves have little correlation with BTC/ETH prices, greater business adoption could increase investor confidence in the broader digital currency infrastructure. For example, if businesses widely adopt USDC to pay employee salaries, that would directly increase USDC’s circulation. In the long term, this could prompt regulators to consider how to bring stablecoins into compliance, potentially creating room for future fintech innovation. However, because it takes time for commercial applications to take hold, the positive impact is likely to be mostly sentiment-driven in the short term and won’t be reflected in prices immediately.

💡 From a data perspective, 90% business acceptance is already quite high. This means stablecoin adoption is no longer the choice of just a handful of pioneers, but is becoming part of a mainstream trend. If more data like Payoneer’s emerges and business adoption continues to rise, it could push stablecoin token prices higher. However, this reasoning would no longer hold if businesses began reducing their use of stablecoins or if a major regulatory crackdown occurred.

📰 企业大规模用稳币值不值得？Payoneer调查90%说OK

Payoneer的一份调查显示，90%使用稳定币的企业认为这种数字货币值得投入精力。这反映了稳定币在商业领域的应用越来越广泛，可能对跨境支付、供应链金融等领域产生变革。对普通投资者来说，这意味着稳定币的实用价值得到越来越多商业机构的认可，未来需求可能进一步提升。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这项调查表明，稳定币的价值正在从投机炒作转向实际应用。商业机构通常比个人投资者更注重效率和成本控制，他们选择稳定币可能是因为它能在跨境交易中避免传统货币的汇率波动和手续费。这背后是商业场景对低成本、高速度国际支付的需求，而稳定币恰好能部分满足这种需求。同时，这也意味着稳定币正在逐步建立自己的经济基础，而不仅仅是金融衍生品。

对市场的影响
从短期看，这个新闻会提振稳定币相关的代币情绪。虽然稳定币本身价格与BTC/ETH关联度不大，但商业的接受度提升会带动投资者对整个数字货币基础设施的信心。比如，如果企业大规模采用USDC支付员工工资，将直接提升USDC的流通量。从长期看，这会推动监管机构考虑如何让稳定币合规化，可能为未来的金融科技创新提供政策空间。但短期内，由于商业应用落地需要时间，这种利好更多是情绪上的，不会立刻反映在价格上。

💡 从数据角度看，目前90%的企业接受度已经很高，这意味着稳定币的采用不再是少数先驱者的选择，而是成为主流趋势的一部分。如果未来出现更多类似Payoneer的数据，且商业采用率持续上升，可能会推动稳定币的代币价格上涨。但这个判断如果企业开始减少使用稳定币，或者出现重大监管打击，则逻辑就不成立了。

Lending vault deposits hit the trending list｜S&P says deposits are about $10 billion｜For ETH, focus on risk first—don’t chase the rally

My stance is cautious observation. Binance Square’s #CryptoVaultDepositsTop$10Billion has risen to the top of the trending topics, but “$10 billion” does not mean funds flowed into Ethereum today. S&P Global Ratings’ official announcement on October 4 stated that digital-asset lending vault deposits were about $10 billion as of September 2026, compared with about $1.5 billion in September 2024. It also introduced a vault risk-assessment methodology that analyzes the credit risks of underlying assets and lending markets, protocol and blockchain risks, and curators’ ability to maintain risk allocations. These figures describe existing deposits, and the assessment is a risk-evaluation framework—not an announcement of spot ETH buying, nor a guarantee of returns for every vault. In particular, figures for “deposits,” “TVL,” and “curated assets” from different dates and platforms on the topic page should not be added together and presented as new funds entering the market today.

Why should ETH traders pay attention to this topic? Lending vaults allocate stablecoins, ETH, and other collateral assets on-chain. If they use Ethereum mainnet, their activity could increase demand for transactions and settlement. But funds may also be deployed on layer 2s or other chains, and stablecoin deposits do not necessarily mean ETH is being bought. What really matters is sustainable activity and risk pricing—not inferring a token-price move from a single large figure. Vault returns primarily depend on lending counterparties and collateral arrangements. Liquidations, oracles, smart contracts, curator permissions, and withdrawal liquidity could all come under pressure during volatile markets. The assessment mentioned in S&P’s announcement is also only a forward-looking opinion on relative risk, not a certification of zero risk.

As for the market, at the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,409, with an intraday range of $2,326–$2,444 and an opening price of about $2,408. It has rebounded notably from the intraday low, but is essentially flat versus the open. I can’t conclude from this that the rebound was driven by the vault news. $2,444 is the near-term upper boundary, around $2,400 is the current battleground, and $2,326 is the intraday low. These are observation levels, not guaranteed support or resistance. If the price pushes above $2,444 but quickly falls back below $2,400, the rationale for chasing the rally is invalidated. If it breaks below $2,326 and fails to recover, I would raise my short-term risk assessment.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter a position solely because of the “$10 billion in vaults” headline. I would only consider a low-leverage spot long after confirmation, with a planned position size of no more than 3% of total capital. The entry trigger would be ETH holding above $2,444 convincingly and then retesting it without losing that level, alongside improvement in trading volume and mainnet activity. The first target would be around $2,480; I would take half off there and hold the rest for $2,520. The stop would be below the retest low, with a hard exit no later than a break below $2,400. If mainnet activity and evidence of capital flows fail to follow through after entry, or a protocol security incident occurs, I would close the position proactively even before the target is reached. If the price first breaks below $2,326, this long setup is canceled outright, and I would stay flat while waiting for the market to reprice. I would act only when the trigger conditions are met; a “plan” is not a completed trade.

Sources: S&P Global Ratings’ official announcement dated October 4; live ETH/USD market data from Kraken. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #扛单 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold on to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” But notice: that thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price.
It only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and tune out bad news. That’s called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple in theory, but hard to follow: before you open a position, write down exactly “what would invalidate the logic behind this trade,”
then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

3. 美股开盘初段给出短线支撑：标普约涨 0.4%，纳指约涨 0.9%，此前受压的 AI 链出现反弹。AI 交易是当前全球风险偏好的温度计，芯片与云算力股若继续走强，通常有利于 ETH、SOL 等高 Beta 资产；若冲高回落，币圈反弹的质量也要重新评估。

4. 油价和美债收益率回落，为风险资产减压。布伦特原油回落至约 107 美元附近，市场消化部分俄罗斯相关制裁豁免；较低的能源与收益率压力有利于成长股和加密估值。但油价仍处高位，地缘消息一旦反复，通胀预期会迅速重新定价。

5. 传统市场并非全面转暖。欧洲部分市场受政治不确定性拖累，债券收益率仍有上行压力；这意味着今天的美股与加密反弹并非无风险环境下的普涨。对 BTC 而言，美元、长端美债收益率和纳指的方向仍是最直接的外部变量。

6. 本周进入财报与宏观共同定价阶段。特斯拉、Meta 等大型科技公司的业绩预期会检验 AI 资本开支叙事；美联储 10 月 17 日起处于议息前静默期，市场会更依赖数据和利率市场自行调整预期。接下来应关注纳指能否扩大涨幅、10年期美债收益率是否继续回落，以及美元是否转强。

7. 今晚的观察重点不是追逐单一币种，而是看“科技股反弹—收益率回落—BTC 稳住 8.2 万美元”这条链条能否同时成立。若三者同步维持，山寨币的相对强度可能继续；若收益率或油价突然反弹，短线风险偏好会先受冲击。

Myth: I Never Make Mistakes - Market Master.

Trading Psychology | Trading Psychology.
Myth: I Never Make Mistakes - Market Master.
Illusion of Control • Overconfidence

Illusion of Control:
 • Believing that one can control market movements.
 • "My analysis is never wrong; the market is wrong"

Overconfidence:
 • A false sense that you hold the keys to the market

Causes:
 • Excessive confidence in analysis and personal experience
 • Ignoring the element of risk and randomness in the market
 • Believing in the ability to control market movements
 • Repeated successful trades reinforce arrogance and illusion

Impact:
 • Repeated losses due to impulsive decisions
 • Deviation from the established trading plan
 • Increasing risk size without clear logic
• Draining capital and losing discipline

 Practical steps to overcome the illusion of control:
1- Record your trades: note the reason, the result, and the mistake objectively 2- Set a stop loss and commit to it in advance - do not move it emotionally 
3- Separate what you can control: control your plan and management, not the price movement
 4- Adhere to risk management: do not risk more than 1-2% per trade.

Crypto facts 📚 Address poisoning
Address poisoning is when scammers generate fake addresses that have the same first and last few characters as an address you often use, then slip them into your transaction history.
Scammers usually send you a zero-value token transfer from a similar-looking address to make it appear in your transaction history.
You learn the hard way: read the instructions first.
If you frequently transfer stablecoins and use the address $ETH , you’re more likely to be targeted by address poisoning. Current price: 2407.54.

content:
A 20% yield looks attractive until you ask what’s inside the vault.

DeFi lending vaults have crossed a major milestone: deposits now exceed 10 billion USD, up from roughly 4 billion at the start of last year.

But here’s the part many yield hunters overlook.

A vault is not risk free just because deposits and transactions are visible on-chain.

Three risks deserve attention:

Collateral risk: borrowers may be backed by assets that lose value or become difficult to sell.
Liquidity risk: withdrawals can become harder when a market is stressed.
Curator risk: someone still chooses the lending strategy, risk limits and asset exposure.

My take: the next test for DeFi yield products isn’t just how much capital they attract. It’s how transparently they manage risk when markets turn against them.

A high advertised APY is a potential return not proof of safety.

What matters more to you when evaluating a DeFi vault: APY, collateral quality, or the curator’s track record?

JPMorgan Chase expands JPM Coin to Ethereum—how much value can ETH capture? 👀

On October 19, The Block reported, citing a statement from Kinexys, that JPMorgan Chase is expanding its U.S. dollar deposit token, JPM Coin (ticker: JPMD), to Ethereum to serve institutional clients.

For $ETH , the question worth exploring is: now that banks are starting to use public blockchains, how much sustained on-chain demand can they generate?

First, a quick look at the product: JPM Coin represents bank deposits and lets institutional clients transfer funds on-chain. It is not ETH, and the dollar value transferred cannot be counted directly as buying demand for ETH.

📌 Here are three things I’ll be watching for confirmation:

① Is it being used consistently?
Beyond the announcement of support, we need to look at actual transaction counts, active institutions, and whether it continues to be used for payments and asset settlement. A one-time test and daily use represent very different levels of demand.

② How much economic value can usage generate?
Large-value fund transfers do not necessarily generate an equivalent amount of on-chain fees. Settlement value, transaction counts, and fees should be assessed separately. And if citing overall Kinexys business figures, we cannot attribute all of them to the Ethereum mainnet.

③ Does the price hold up after the news?
If ETH later forms a consolidation range, then sees increased spot trading volume and holds a retest after a breakout, that would provide another basis for expecting the trend to continue. If the news is hot but the price keeps spiking and then pulling back, beware of expectations being priced in early.

The significance of this news is that it creates more opportunities to connect bank deposits with public blockchain applications. Whether this can create sustained demand, and how that demand might be reflected in ETH, will require further data to answer.

Institutional services also have eligibility and usage restrictions, so don’t assume that seeing “public blockchain” means anyone can use it freely.

When it comes to institutional adoption of ETH, which number would you most want to see first: active clients, settlement transactions, or on-chain fees? 👇

除了宣布支援，還要看實際交易筆數、活躍機構，以及是否持續用於付款和資產結算。一次測試與每天使用，代表的需求不同。

③ 消息之後，價格有沒有承接？
若 ETH 後續形成整理區間，再出現現貨成交增加、突破後回測守住，才多一層延續行情的依據。若消息熱、價格卻持續衝高回落，就要防範預期提前反映。
