$ETH: Balancing Entry Quality and Chasing in a Volume‑Driven Move

The practical trade‑off
When the hourly direction points down and volume sits above baseline, the temptation to chase a lower price can be strong. Imagine a trader who sees the price near 2405.29 and believes a quick bounce could yield profit. Entering immediately may capture a sharp move, but the entry quality is uncertain because the price is still below the recent support zone. Waiting for a clearer break above 2421.88 or a rebound toward 2420.77 improves entry confidence, yet it also risks missing the move entirely if the downtrend continues.

What changes when the assumption fails
If the price fails to respect the support level, the initial chase could result in a stop loss hit quickly, especially when the average true range 8.60359 suggests a wider volatility envelope. Conversely, waiting longer may allow the price to retrace further, expanding the distance to a meaningful stop and increasing potential loss if the trend reverses unexpectedly. The risk therefore hinges on how tightly the stop is placed relative to the observed volatility and the strength of the volume signal.

A decision checklist
- Does the price sit below the key support level? – 2405.29
- Is the relative volume elevated? – 2.80581
- Can the stop be set at a distance that respects 8.60359 while still protecting capital?
- Would a pause for a confirming bounce toward 2421.88 improve entry quality?

The thought experiment highlights that choosing between immediate entry and patient waiting is not about predicting the next tick but about managing the trade‑off between entry confidence and exposure to rapid adverse moves.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's the Price of Admission for Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can't take it. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most consistent trader I've ever met cuts his losses more decisively than anyone when he's wrong. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when placing a stop-loss, tell
yourself: This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

📰 BlackRock just said it was planning a protected Bitcoin ETF, but now regulators have changed their tune? Why is the world’s largest asset manager betting on this kind of “sandwich cookie”?

Just the other day, we talked about BlackRock launching a protected Bitcoin ETF, and now it has filed another application. The world’s largest asset manager is clearly determined to break into crypto—and this time, it obviously doesn’t want to lose money: the application includes a “principal protection” provision. What does this mean for the crypto market? Put simply, regulators have suddenly changed their tune. Their previous willingness to approve crypto ETFs now seems a bit like saying one thing and meaning another.

Why does this news matter?
This is BlackRock’s third attempt to launch a Bitcoin fund, and its first two were rejected. Why add a “principal-protected” design this time? Simply put, the ETF market is too big to ignore, but BlackRock is wary of putting real money in and taking a loss. Amid pressure from CPI inflation and regulatory rumors, American investors’ fear of the crypto market has reportedly grown from “50% are afraid of losing money” to “80% are afraid of losing money.” An institution with a moat as deep as BlackRock’s would naturally want to create a “safer version.”

Impact on the market
The most immediate effect of this protected ETF on BTC/ETH is that inflows will split in two. Some people just want to profit from Bitcoin’s price rising (bullish), while others just want to earn a little interest and preserve their principal (neutral). That means that once the ETF launches, it won’t trigger a sell-off like a traditional ETF might; instead, it could create a “slow accumulation” effect. As for the price impact: sentiment could be stronger than expected in the short term, because people will see that even the world’s largest asset manager is willing to use this kind of “beginner’s safety net.” But the medium-term trend will depend on other factors affecting capital flows.

Trading strategy
This protective layer could mean that selling pressure above the BTC $80K level suddenly eases. If capital continues to flow in, this ETF could push BTC to $90K or even higher. But the thesis would be invalidated if the U.S. suddenly starts banning these products across the board, or if Bitcoin itself suffers a major technical failure (such as a collapse in hash rate)—in which case, the “principal protection” design would be rendered ineffective. Don’t be too hard on me if I’m wrong; I’m only trying it with a small position myself.

Tether just announced that it had frozen all stablecoin accounts linked to Iran, causing trading volume in those accounts to plummet 94% in a single day. The root of the issue lies in Tether’s position as the world’s largest stablecoin issuer: a single compliance action can completely reshape the financial ecosystem in a particular region. In the long term, this news suggests that stablecoin issuers are becoming an “invisible hand” of financial regulation, potentially prompting other issuers to use similar freezing measures more frequently in response to compliance pressure. There are few comparable historical events, but when the SWIFT system suspended services over sanctions against Iran in 2019, the crypto market briefly saw a flight to safety.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Have to Afford the Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means risking no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can get you back to break-even. By contrast, lose 30% every time you go all-in,
and after three losses in a row, you’re left with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re all but finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits your stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out your position size.

Geth identifies ABI integer truncation boundary | Fix still under review | ETH holds 2380; don't chase the development news

My stance is to watch cautiously. On October 19, Ethereum execution client Geth saw a new code-fix proposal: PR #35972 proposes rejecting inputs larger than 256 bits when packing unsigned integers in the ABI. The example given by the proposal's author is passing 2 to the power of 256 as a uint256 parameter. The old code path could silently truncate it to zero without returning an error; the proposed patch would instead return an error. The Geth repository page shows that the PR is still Open and awaiting review by code owners. It has not been merged or released, and this is certainly not a case of funds being stolen or a consensus incident on mainnet. The official Solidity ABI specification also states that standard integer encoding is constrained by a 256-bit word size, so these two primary sources can be cross-checked to clarify the scope of the issue.

This kind of issue is worth traders' attention, but not worth causing panic. It concerns the risk of input encoding when applications or tools construct contract calls: if upstream calculations produce an abnormally large number and the caller does not check the actual packed result, the “parameter intended for sending” could differ from the “parameter actually put on-chain.” This does not mean that ETH transfers within the normal range will automatically turn into zero, nor does it justify inferring that any project has already suffered losses. If the fix is ultimately approved, it would mainly make developer errors more visible and improve the predictability of wallets and contract calls. Any effect on the price of ETH would come through long-term infrastructure trust, not a sudden increase in spot buying today.

The market reaction should also be described honestly: when I checked, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,399.6, slightly below the daily open of $2,405.4, with an intraday range of $2,382.8 to $2,443.7. This price snapshot alone cannot prove that the decline was caused by this PR; macro risk appetite, BTC's direction, and ETF flows may all be affecting ETH at the same time. For now, the first thing to watch is whether the price can hold near 2380, followed by the daily open at 2405. A short-term recovery is not in view unless it breaks above around 2445. If the price remains below 2380 and the rebound is weak, my view that the range will stabilize is invalidated. Even if the patch is merged later, the price may not rise immediately.

If I were trading this myself, I would neither chase a short nor rush to buy the rebound. I would only consider spot or a small long position with exposure of no more than 1x. The trigger would be ETH reclaiming 2405 and holding above 2400 on a retest, while also confirming that the Geth PR's status has not been misreported as already deployed. If those conditions are met, I would enter with no more than 1% of total capital. The first target is 2445, where I would sell half; the second target is 2465, where I would close the remaining position in batches rather than get greedy for further gains. The initial stop-loss would be below 2380. If, after entry, the price loses 2400 again and cannot quickly recover, I would exit early. If the PR reveals further risks, or the broader market breaks key support at the same time, I would cancel the buy plan. If no trigger occurs, I would stay in cash; code-review news is not a reason to take a large position.

Sources: ethereum/go-ethereum PR #35972 and its changes page; Solidity ABI specification. Price: live snapshot from Kraken. #ETH

The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Geth发现ABI整数截断边界｜修复仍在评审｜ETH守2380，不追开发利好

我的态度是谨慎观察。以太坊执行客户端Geth在10月19日出现一份新的代码修复提案：PR #35972拟在ABI打包无符号整数时，拒绝大于256位的输入。提案作者展示的例子是，把2的256次方作为uint256参数传入，旧路径可能静默截成零而没有报错；拟议补丁改为返回错误。Geth仓库页面显示它目前仍是Open，正在等待代码所有者审阅，不是已合并、已发布，更不是主网发生盗币或共识事故。Solidity官方ABI规范也说明标准整数编码受256位字长约束，两份一手资料可以互相校准问题的边界。

这类问题值得交易者关注，却不值得制造恐慌。它针对的是应用或工具在构造合约调用时的输入编码风险：若上游计算先产生异常超大数字，而调用方又未检查实际打包结果，就可能出现“想发送的参数”和“实际上链的参数”不一致。它不意味着正常范围内的ETH转账会自动变成零，也不能据此推断某个项目已经蒙受损失。修复若最终通过，主要改善开发者错误显性化和钱包、合约调用的可预期性；对ETH价格的传导属于长期基础设施信任，而不是今天突然多出一笔现货买盘。

市场反应也要诚实描述：我查看Kraken ETH/USD约2399.6美元，较日开2405.4略低，日内在2382.8至2443.7美元之间。仅凭这个价格截面，无法证明下跌由这份PR引起；同期宏观风险偏好、BTC方向和ETF资金都可能影响ETH。当前先看2380附近能否守住，其次是2405的日开位置，向上需突破2445附近才谈短线修复。若价格持续跌破2380且反抽无力，我对区间企稳的判断就被推翻；即便补丁随后合并，价格也未必立刻上涨。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追空也不抢反弹，方向只预设现货或不超过一倍敞口的小仓试多。触发条件是ETH重新站上2405，并在回踩时保持2400上方，同时确认Geth PR的状态没有被误传成已部署；届时最多用总资金1%入场。第一目标2445，触及时减半；第二目标2465，剩余仓位分批平仓，不贪延伸。初始止损设在2380下方，若入场后再失守2400且不能迅速收回，也提前平仓。若PR披露进一步风险、或大盘同时跌破关键支撑，则撤销买入计划。没有触发就保持现金，代码评审新闻不构成重仓理由。

🚨 Just said Google was going to tighten crypto ad rules in the UAE, and now—suddenly—it’s issuing licenses

I just talked about this a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. The UAE has announced that, starting October 21, Google will allow ads for crypto exchanges and wallets—but only if they first obtain a new license. In short, Google isn’t imposing a blanket ban; it’s opening a green lane for compliant businesses, but the bar is clearly higher.

Why does this news matter? It means the UAE is pushing crypto services toward becoming part of the “establishment.” In the past, just about any project could advertise. Now, businesses must first pass local regulatory approval. That’s certainly a good thing: it can increase trust in compliant projects, making it easier for users to tell which exchanges are reliable. The problem is that the new licensing requirements may only suit big players; small teams simply may not have the resources to meet them. This could make the UAE crypto market increasingly oligopolistic, squeezing smaller projects out. That’s the complete opposite of the approach we’ve seen in the U.S., where exchanges can be shut down at the drop of a hat. The UAE is doing the reverse: “fewer, but better regulated.”

The impact on the market will mainly be felt in sentiment. In the short term, this could give BTC and ETH prices in the Middle East a boost in confidence, since they now have the backing of the world’s second-largest internet platform. But over the long term, if only top projects can advertise, others will have to move to different regions or build their own audiences, which could reduce market activity. Historically, after the U.S. bank advertising ban in 2009, the crypto industry actually accelerated its move toward decentralization. Will the UAE’s licensing system push things in the opposite direction? It’s worth watching.

💡 Personal view: I think this benefits ETH more directly than BTC. ETH is more closely tied to wallets and the DApp ecosystem, so the UAE’s favorable advertising rules could help increase ETH adoption. But this benefit could be undermined if Europe suddenly follows the U.S. and starts imposing stricter regulations.

📰 SkyAI suddenly empties its Solana treasury, holding $223.8M in cash for buybacks: Why are even major players starting to get nervous?

SkyAI, a significant project in the Solana ecosystem, has suddenly announced its exit from Solana's treasury, holding on to $223.8M in cash to fund buybacks. This has raised three big questions: First, why is SkyAI abandoning Solana, once the crypto world's “expressway”? Second, what exactly can it do with the cash it buys back? Third, could other companies following suit end up completely dragging down the Solana ecosystem?

Why does this news matter?
At first glance, SkyAI's move seems simple, but it actually sends a signal. The crypto world has been shifting from “land-grab frenzy” to “cash flow is king” for a while now, but it's still rare for a company like SkyAI to completely empty its treasury. This means a few things: First, project teams are no longer blindly convinced that a particular blockchain can deliver “exponential growth” and are starting to prioritize the safety of their funds. Second, Solana's recent network issues (such as fluctuating TPS and high transaction fees) may have put them under enough pressure. Third, buybacks—whether stock or token buybacks—are becoming a new favorite for boosting company valuations, while cash reserves are proving more tangible than blockchain points.

Market impact
In the short term, this may have little direct impact on BTC and ETH, since $223.8M is still a drop in the bucket compared with the size of the overall market. But over the medium to long term, this reflects a shift in the mindset of major players: once a blockchain loses its “halo,” funds may quickly flow out. This means Solana needs to prove its value and retain project teams and users, or it could face an exodus from its ecosystem. 🚨 Why Could Google’s UAE Ad Certification Undermine Diversity in the Cryptocurrency Market?

Google has announced that, starting October 21, it will open certification to cryptocurrency, forex, and CFD advertisers in the UAE. This may sound like regulatory progress, but it could accelerate the industry’s winner-take-all effect. According to CryptoBriefing, the move is intended to screen for more compliant providers. In the short term, it could boost public confidence in regulated projects, but over the long term, innovative projects with limited budgets may be forced out of the market by high advertising costs.

Overview
Google has introduced an ad certification program in the UAE, requiring cryptocurrency service providers to comply with local regulations before they can advertise. This is similar to the EU’s DORA regulation, which sets industry standards through technical requirements. The program affects all projects seeking to attract customers in the region, especially smaller teams, as obtaining certification may require more resources.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?
This marks a substantive step toward crypto regulation by a major Middle Eastern economy. Google is the world’s largest gateway to online traffic, and its advertising policies directly affect barriers to entry in the industry. The underlying reason is that regulators worldwide are using traffic controls to shape the market. The UAE’s move is simply following the trend set by the EU, the US, and other regions. Unlike the SEC’s recent approval of spot Bitcoin ETFs, the UAE’s certification program focuses more on local regulation and is less likely to directly affect global liquidity, but it will create a regional compliance barrier.

Market impact
The short-term effect on sentiment toward BTC/ETH may be neutral to slightly negative. Greater compliance could attract traditional investors, but may squeeze the room for decentralized projects to survive. A historical example is Facebook’s 2017 ban on crypto ads, after which market volatility actually increased as projects surged in number. The difference this time is that Google is much bigger, but the UAE market is far smaller than the global market, so the knock-on effects will be limited. Tighter regulation may push some projects toward promotional channels that are not subject to the same restrictions, such as independent websites or small-scale community marketing.

💡 Simply put: If compliant projects gain more traffic while smaller projects are forced out, the market will start to look more like an “oligopoly.” For now, $BTC  and $ETH  are unlikely to see dramatic changes as a result, but it is worth watching whether certified projects develop a new premium tier.

谷歌在阿联酋推出广告认证计划，要求加密货币服务商符合当地法规才能投放广告。这类似于欧盟的 DORA 法规，通过技术标准规范行业。受影响的是所有希望在该地区获客的项目，尤其是预算较小的团队，因为通过认证可能需要投入更多资源。

💡 简单说：如果合规项目能获得更多流量，但小项目被迫退出，那么市场会变得更像"寡头游戏"。目前看，$BTC 和 $ETH 不会因此出现剧烈变化，但需要关注受认证项目是否会形成新的溢价层。

subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，

分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。

translatedData.title: Scale Out to Take Profits: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Your Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out approach to taking profits that I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer result in a loss, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: when the price reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding the elevator back to where you started.

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. Why STRC? It may represent an area they want to bet heavily on, but that isn’t directly tied to BTC for now.

🧭 Decentralized social media changes hands again: Will Farcaster become freer, or more strictly governed?

On October 15, Network School, founded by Balaji Srinivasan, took over Farcaster’s app, protocol codebase, and related products from Neynar. The deal amount was not disclosed. This is the second time Farcaster has changed hands this year (Neynar took over from Merkle Manufactory in January).

📌 Key changes:
• The platform will be renamed “Network State Protocol,” with the goal of building opt-in digital communities
• Users will need to sign an on-chain “social smart contract” to receive an access NFT; those who decline will retain read-only access
• The accompanying “Network Code” divides violations into digital felonies, misdemeanors, and infractions, with penalties ranging from warnings and suspensions to permanent muting
• The plan is to moderate content using open-source, weighted AI models, and gradually introduce human verification
• The underlying protocol will remain open. Users who decline to sign can keep their keys, follows, and content history, and migrate to other clients

⚠️ Controversy: On the day of the takeover, some users reported that they had been restricted to read-only access because of old posts, prompting the community to question whether this runs counter to the spirit of decentralized social media.

📊 Market impact:
This is more about the social and governance narrative than a direct catalyst for prices. But it’s a reminder that the operation and rules of a decentralized app’s “front end” may be more centralized than the protocol itself.
ETH is currently around 2408 USDT, with a high of about 2725 and a recent low of about 2318 over the past two weeks. Watch the 2318–2330 support zone, with resistance near 2500.

🧭 去中心化社交再次易主：Farcaster 会更自由，还是规则更严？

10 月 15 日，Balaji Srinivasan 创办的 Network School 从 Neynar 手中接手了 Farcaster 的应用、协议代码库和相关产品，交易金额未披露。这是 Farcaster 今年第二次换主人（1 月由 Neynar 从 Merkle Manufactory 手中接过）。

📌 关键变化：
• 平台将更名为「Network State Protocol」，目标是建设可选择加入的数字社群
• 用户需签署链上「社交智能合约」，签署后获得访问 NFT；拒绝者保留只读权限
• 配套「Network Code」把违规分为数字重罪、轻罪和违规，处罚从警告、封禁到永久禁言
• 计划用开源权重 AI 模型审核内容，并逐步引入真人验证
• 底层协议仍保持开放，拒签用户可保留密钥、关注关系和历史内容，迁移到其他客户端

⚠️ 争议：接手当天就有用户反映因旧帖被限制为只读，社区质疑这与去中心化社交的精神相悖。

📊 对市场的影响：
这更多是社交与治理叙事，不是直接的价格利好。但它提醒我们：去中心化应用「前端」的运营权和规则，可能比协议本身更中心化。

Millions of crypto holders in the U.S. are getting their taxes wrong without even knowing it—and a new bill has just opened up a real way out.

H.R. 10357 has just been approved in a vote by the U.S. House Financial Services Committee. Section 502 of the bill would allow the U.S. Treasury to establish a voluntary crypto disclosure program for 12 months after the bill takes effect.

Here’s how it works: if you made an unintentional mistake—not deliberate fraud—and your unpaid capital gains tax is less than $25,000 per year, the penalty is 0%. You’d just have to pay the original tax owed plus interest on the late payment. Any amount above that threshold would still be subject to a penalty, but at a much lower rate than the usual range (typically 20–40%).

Why does this matter to the broader market? The IRS is about to tighten reporting through Form 1099-DA. Many investors are sitting on DeFi, staking, and airdrops from years ago, unsure how to handle them. If passed in full, this bill could unlock capital that’s been psychologically “frozen”—and it’s entirely possible that money could flow back into the market.

$BTC  is around $81,962, $ETH  is hovering around $2,405, and $SOL  is up 1.6% over the past 24 hours at the time of writing. The market is reacting pretty sensitively to U.S. regulatory signals.

I don’t know whether the bill will pass the Senate—that’s a risk to keep in mind. But this direction suggests that the crypto regulatory framework in the U.S. is gradually becoming clearer. Do your own research and manage your positions before getting your hopes up too soon.

Take a look at the charts for $BTC  and $ETH  below and see how prices reacted to this week’s regulatory news! 👇

Dự luật này nếu được thông qua hoàn toàn sẽ giải phóng một lượng vốn đang bị "đóng băng tâm lý" — dòng tiền đó quay lại thị trường là điều hoàn toàn có thể xảy ra.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether to use one at all. Place it too close and you’ll get stopped out constantly; too far away and one loss can be devastating.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suits beginners
who want to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place your stop where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level is broken, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: the wider the stop-loss distance, the smaller your position, so the loss on any single trade stays at

The ATR shows an average true range of around $15.85 over 14 periods, indicating low volatility. The Parabolic SAR is at $2,427, above the current price, and continues to signal bearish conditions.

Across 15 quantitative factors, three are giving buy signals, 11 are giving sell signals, and one is neutral. Notably, however, the composite indicator is signaling a buy, with a historical win rate of around 73%. This suggests that despite bearish short-term factors, the medium-term composite signal points to a bullish direction.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The biggest headwind facing Ethereum is ongoing outflows from ETFs. US spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for three consecutive weeks, with outflows of around $320 million last week and cumulative outflows nearing $1 billion in October. This has significantly weakened market confidence and is one of the key reasons expectations for an “October rally” have not materialized.

However, institutional positioning is accelerating. Kinexys, JPMorgan Chase's blockchain division, has deployed JPM Coin on the Ethereum mainnet, allowing institutional clients to transfer tokenized dollars around the clock with near-instant settlement. This expansion from Base to the Ethereum mainnet signals growing confidence among traditional financial institutions in Ethereum as a settlement layer.

In terms of corporate accumulation, BitMine has recently purchased a total of 12,535 ETH, reflecting corporate treasuries' long-term optimism about Ethereum. Germany's Sparkassen banking network has also launched retail Ethereum trading services, broadening access for European retail investors.

On-chain data shows net inflows of around $27.67 million near Ethereum's intraday low, helping drive a rebound from $2,395 to $2,437 before the price pulled back into consolidation. This dip-buying suggests that support at the market bottom is relatively firm.

Growth in the stablecoin market is also benefiting the Ethereum ecosystem. Stablecoin payment volume reached $482 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, up 45% year over year, while the number of transactions exceeded 1 billion, up 71%. Mastercard, Stripe, and Visa have all integrated stablecoin payment channels, and on-chain card spending reached $3.9 billion—10 times last year's level. As a major network for stablecoin issuance, Ethereum stands to benefit directly from this growth trend.

On the risk front, Russia's proposed ban on self-custody wallets could have a localized impact on decentralized access, although the overall effect is likely to be limited. The $1.4 million hack involving the Qubic chain is also a reminder for the market to pay attention to the security of Layer 1 networks.

Overall, Ethereum is in a short-term consolidation phase, with $2,385 to $2,445 as its key trading range. JPMorgan's deployment of JPM Coin on-chain and continued corporate accumulation provide solid medium- to long-term support. Watch for a breakout above $2,450 and whether ETF flows can stabilize.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构布局加速，短期蓄势待发

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二十日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报二千四百零八美元附近，过去二十四小时内微涨百分之零点三一。从小时级别K线观察，价格在二千三百九十一至二千四百一十八美元区间内运行，整体呈现温和反弹后的高位整理格局。

近五个小时的走势显示，以太坊经历了探底回升的过程。第一个小时从二千四百零一美元开盘，最低下探至二千三百九十一美元后收于二千三百九十五美元；随后两个小时逐步回升至二千四百零二美元上方；第四个小时出现明显拉升，最高触及二千四百一十八美元，成交量放大至一千零五十五万美元；最新一根K线开盘二千四百零七美元，维持在二千四百零七美元附近窄幅波动。

布林带指标显示，上轨约二千四百四十三美元，中轨约二千四百一十四美元，下轨约二千三百八十五美元。价格目前运行在中轨上方，略偏强势，但距离上轨仍有约三十五美元的空间，说明短期上行通道尚未打开。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线约二千四百零二美元，二十五小时均线约二千四百一十五美元，九十九小时均线约二千四百一十九美元。三条均线呈现空头排列，短周期均线均位于长周期均线下方，表明中期趋势仍偏弱。指数移动平均线同样如此，七周期EMA约二千四百零四美元，二十五周期EMA约二千四百零八美元，九十九周期EMA约二千四百二十美元。

MACD指标方面，DIF线约负一点八一，信号线约负零点六一，柱状图约负一点二零。MACD三线均在零轴下方运行，但柱状图负值从三点五零收窄到一点二零，空头动能明显衰减。DIF线正在向信号线靠拢，若形成金叉将释放看多信号。

RSI指标表现积极，六周期RSI约五十二点八五，十二周期RSI约四十九点六五，二十四周期RSI约四十九点二七。短周期RSI已回升至五十上方，显示短期多方力量有所增强。KDJ指标中，K值约四十五点八九，D值约三十七点七四，J值约六十二点一八，三线呈多头排列且持续上行，这是较为明确的短期看多信号。

威廉指标从负八十三点八六大幅回升至负五十九点五一，已经脱离超卖区域，正在向中性区域靠拢。ATR指标显示十四周期平均真实波幅约十五点八五美元，波动率较低。抛物线SAR指标位于二千四百二十七美元，高于当前价格，仍维持看空信号。

综合十五个量化因子来看，三个发出做多信号，十一个发出做空信号，一个中性。但值得注意的是，复合指标信号为做多，历史胜率约百分之七十三，这说明尽管短期因子偏空，但中期复合信号指向看多方向。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的最大压力来自ETF持续流出。美国现货以太坊ETF已连续三周录得净流出，上周流出约三点二亿美元，十月累计流出接近十亿美元。这一数据严重打击了市场信心，也是"十月上涨"预期落空的重要原因之一。

然而，机构层面的布局正在加速。摩根大通旗下区块链部门Kinexys已将JPM Coin部署到以太坊主网，允许机构客户全天候进行美元代币转账，实现近乎即时结算。这一举措从Base扩展至以太坊主网，标志着传统金融机构对以太坊作为结算层的信心进一步增强。

企业增持方面，BitMine近期累计购入一万二千五百三十五枚ETH，显示企业财库对以太坊的长期看好。德国Sparkassen银行网络也推出了以太坊零售交易服务，扩大了欧洲散户的参与渠道。

链上数据方面，以太坊在日内低点附近出现约二千七百六十七万美元的资金净流入，推动价格从二千三百九十五美元反弹至二千四百三十七美元后回落整理。这种逢低买入行为说明市场底部支撑较为坚实。

稳定币市场的发展也为以太坊生态带来利好。二零二六年前三季度稳定币支付量达到四千八百二十亿美元，同比增长百分之四十五，交易笔数突破十亿，同比增长百分之七十一。万事达卡、Stripe和Visa均已接入稳定币支付通道，链上卡消费达到三十九亿美元，是去年的十倍。以太坊作为稳定币发行的主要网络，将直接受益于这一增长趋势。

风险方面，俄罗斯提出的自托管钱包禁令可能对去中心化访问造成局部影响，但整体影响有限。Qubic链遭遇的一点四百万美元黑客事件则提醒市场关注Layer一网络的安全问题。

总体判断，以太坊短期处于蓄势阶段，二千三百八十五美元至二千四百四十五美元为核心波动区间。摩根大通JPM Coin上链和企业持续增持为中长期提供了坚实支撑。建议关注二千四百五十美元突破情况以及ETF资金流能否企稳。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll look at how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp drop from a “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
short, but rather: be extra cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like this.

BitMine added 12,535 ETH last week | Holdings exceed 6.04 million ETH | Waiting for confirmation around 2,400

My stance is cautious to neutral. Corporate treasury purchases of ETH represent real demand, but they cannot be presented today as a guarantee that the price must rise. This round of Trending Topics and Most Searched on Binance Square has no popular tags directly related to BitMine’s increased holdings, so this post sticks to the relevant discussion tag, #ETH, rather than borrowing unrelated topics. As for the market, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,405 at the time of writing, with a daily open around $2,408 and an intraday range of $2,383–$2,444. The price is near its opening level rather than making a one-way move, so at least for now, there is no clear sign that the announcement has been uniformly interpreted by the market as a bullish breakout.

The primary facts come from a company announcement BitMine published on October 19 and submitted to the SEC as an exhibit. As of 3 p.m. Eastern Time on October 18, the company held 6,041,481 ETH, approximately 4.9% of the 122.1 million ETH supply figure cited in the announcement. The company said it had purchased an additional 12,535 ETH over the past week. Another 5,067,309 ETH had been staked, about 84% of its ETH holdings, and the company also disclosed a combined $582 million in cash and marketable securities. The company’s goal is to hold 5% of the supply; that is a management target, not an already achieved result. The announcement’s annualized staking yield figure is an estimate based on assumptions and should not be treated as profit already received. The SEC 8-K explicitly lists the press release as an exhibit, corroborating the disclosure channel.

Why does this matter? Ongoing treasury purchases reduce the amount of spot ETH available to other buyers in the short term, while staking puts some of those assets into validator activity, potentially affecting market expectations around liquidity and demand for yield. But staked ETH is not permanently burned. Unstaking arrangements, the company’s financing conditions, and price volatility can all change the circulating supply and selling pressure. More importantly, a single company’s highly concentrated holdings also create downside risks: if conditions for equity financing tighten, its future pace of purchases may not continue at the rate seen over the past week. BitMine’s chairman being bullish is a subjective outlook and should not be conflated with the holdings and purchases already disclosed. Changes in the valuation of the company’s other assets also cannot be directly interpreted as net inflows into ETH.

My key levels to watch are the round-number level of 2,400, the intraday low of 2,383, and the high of 2,444. If ETH holds above 2,400 but repeatedly fails to break through 2,444, that would suggest buyers are still working within the range. If it falls below 2,383 and fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my short-term cautiously stable view would be invalidated. Even if a breakout follows, I would want to see ETH spot volume and broader risk assets move in tandem; a treasury announcement alone is not enough to conclude that a rally has begun. If the company later formally discloses a decline in its holdings or a substantial change in its staking ratio, the existing supply-and-demand narrative will need to be reassessed.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider a spot long only if certain conditions are met. I would use 2% of my total capital to open a test position only if ETH/USD breaks above 2,444, holds on a retest, and remains above that level over the following hour. I would take half off at the first target of 2,475, then gradually close the rest at the second target of 2,510. After entering, I would stop out if the price falls back to 2,418. If there is no volume within two days and the price loses 2,400 again, I would exit proactively. If it first breaks below 2,383, I would cancel the long setup, stay in cash, and avoid using leverage to bet that the company will keep buying. These are trading conditions that have not yet been triggered, not a recap of completed trades or profits.

Sources: BitMine company announcement dated October 19, SEC 8-K exhibit, Kraken ETH/USD. #ETH

BitMine上周增持12,535枚ETH｜持仓逾604万枚｜2400附近我等确认

我的态度是审慎偏中性。企业财库买入ETH是真实发生的需求，但今天不能把它写成价格必涨的保证。币安广场本轮Trending Topics和Most Searched没有直接对应BitMine增持的热门标签，所以这篇只保留实际讨论的#ETH，不借用无关话题。行情方面，Kraken ETH/USD写稿约2405美元，日开约2408，日内在2383至2444之间波动；价格接近开盘位而非走出单边，至少目前看不出公告已被市场一致解读为强势突破。

一手事实是BitMine于10月19日发布、并作为附件提交SEC的公司公告。截至10月18日美东时间下午3点，企业持有6,041,481枚ETH，约占公告所用1.221亿枚供应量的4.9%；公司称过去一周新增买入12,535枚。另有5,067,309枚已质押，约占其自有ETH的84%，同时披露现金及可交易证券合计5.82亿美元。公司追求持有5%供应量，这是管理层目标，不是已经完成的结果；公告的年化质押收益数字是基于假设的估算，也不能当作已到账利润。SEC 8-K明确是将新闻稿作为附件提供，交叉验证了披露路径。

这为什么重要？持续的财库买入减少了短期可供其他买家获得的现货数量，质押又使其中一部分资产进入验证活动，可能影响市场对流动性和收益需求的预期。但质押ETH并非永久销毁，相关解质押安排、公司融资条件和币价波动都会改变可流通供给与卖压。更关键的是，单一企业持仓过于集中也带来反向风险：如果其股票融资环境收紧，未来买入节奏不一定沿用过去一周。BitMine董事长看多属于主观展望，不能与已经披露的持仓和购买量混为一谈；公司的其他资产估值变化，也不能直接解释为ETH净流入。

我的关键观察位是2400整数位、日内低点2383和高点2444。若ETH站稳2400但始终无法穿过2444，说明买盘仍在区间内消化；若跌破2383且反抽失败，短线偏稳判断失效。即使后续突破，也要看ETH现货量能与更广泛风险资产是否同步，不能只凭财库公告认定行情已经启动。若公司后续正式披露持仓下降或质押比例大幅变化，原有供需叙事也要重新核验。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向仅保留条件式现货多单。只有ETH/USD突破2444、回踩守住并在下一小时维持其上，才用总资金2%试仓；第一目标2475先减半，第二目标2510逐步平仓。入场后跌回2418就止损；若两天内无量、重新失守2400，也主动退出。若先跌破2383，我取消多头计划，保持空仓，不加杠杆赌企业继续买入。这里是尚未触发的交易条件，不是已经成交或盈利的复盘。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts.
The two sides pay each other; the exchange only collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how does the price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money changes hands between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds set aside when you open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: When losses eat into your maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

📰 Why does Quantinuum’s quantum computing breakthrough pose a greater challenge to Bitcoin encryption?

Quantinuum announced a major advance in quantum error correction, achieving 99.9995% logical fidelity. This breakthrough could bring commercial quantum computers sooner than expected, and machines of this kind could crack existing encryption algorithms, threatening the security foundations of Bitcoin. This is potentially negative news for all digital assets that rely on traditional encryption, but the extent of the impact depends on when quantum computers can actually be deployed.

Why does this news matter?
The level of error correction in quantum computing directly determines the timeline for commercialization. Quantinuum’s new record suggests that the threshold for “fault-tolerant quantum computing” (targeted for 2029) could be reached sooner than expected. Cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin currently use elliptic curve cryptography, which quantum computers can efficiently crack. If quantum computers become viable on schedule, the useful lifespan of existing encryption systems could be significantly shortened.

Market impact
In the short term, major cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum could face selling pressure amid security concerns. Historical data shows that news of major technological breakthroughs often triggers market volatility at first. In the longer term, the relationship between crypto assets and quantum computing looks more like a battle between “attack and defense”—the crypto community is also researching quantum-resistant algorithms. For now, the quantum threat is a key factor over the medium term, but its actual impact depends on how quickly quantum computers become more energy-efficient.

💡 Cryptocurrencies could face pressure from security concerns in the short term, but the actual impact depends on when quantum computers can crack existing algorithms. If, within the next two years, quantum computers can use quadrillion operations per second to crack Bitcoin private keys, the current cryptocurrency ecosystem would need to switch to quantum-resistant algorithms immediately. If quantum computers remain confined to the laboratory, the impact of this news will gradually fade.

VITALIK PROPOSES CHANGING HOW ETHEREUM PROCESSES CRYPTOGRAPHY.

Vitalik Buterin has once again turned the spotlight on Ethereum’s technical architecture with EIP-8288, a proposal aimed at simplifying the verification of complex cryptographic operations and making it easier to incorporate new security schemes.

The central idea is to bundle digital signatures and cryptographic proofs into a single recursive STARK proof. Rather than requiring the network to process each resource-intensive element separately, mempool nodes could combine these proofs before validators check their validity.

The goal is to reduce verification costs and the volume of data that must circulate across the network, especially as signatures resistant to future quantum attacks come into use.

- Some of these signatures take up several kilobytes, while certain STARK proofs can exceed 128 KB.

The proposal also aims to prevent Ethereum from having to add a new built-in cryptographic function every time a different scheme emerges. This could give it more flexibility to adapt to future security technologies.

EIP-8288 was co-authored by Buterin and Thomas Coratger, and remains in draft status. Its implementation will depend on technical decisions and whether it is potentially included in a future network upgrade.

For now, the debate centers on how to enable Ethereum to verify advanced cryptography at lower cost, without relying on specific changes for each new system.

Put simply: whether you can buy a company’s “stock token” on-chain will depend not just on the exchange, but also on whether the company gives the green light.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just pick one at random and end up paying dearly.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as collateral. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
basket, with everything supporting everything else.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case outcome of a single bad trade

Where ETH proofs should go is still under discussion｜Header and payload each come with trade-offs｜Manage risk first around $2,400

My stance is to wait and see, and not to treat a research draft as an upgrade already implemented on Ethereum mainnet. EIP-8288 aims to aggregate larger signatures or proofs into recursive STARKs, reducing the burden of repeated verification and transmission. A new EIPs PR #12549, opened on October 19, proposes a specific design change: put only the proof hash and dependency hashes in the block header, and move the proof itself to a field in the execution payload. The author’s reasoning is to keep the block header compact, which would help in some partial-sync scenarios. However, this PR is still a Draft, and the page explicitly says it is awaiting review by the author; the official EIP-8288 page is also marked Draft, so this is not a confirmed rule for the next mainnet upgrade.

More importantly, reviewers have raised an unresolved retrieval issue: if the proof is in neither the block header nor the conventional block body, where will execution-layer nodes get it during synchronization? Also, “unable to verify locally” and “the proof has been verified and found invalid” cannot be conflated under the same error code. The author acknowledged in the discussion that some additional method of retrieving proofs would be needed, and that there is no agreement yet with other proposals that put proofs in the block body. For traders, these may seem like minor details, but they determine node synchronization, verification responsibilities, network bandwidth, and the cost of recovering from failures. Until the design converges, it is impossible to calculate a definite gas saving, let alone claim that ETH will attract new institutional buying as a result.

I first checked Binance Square’s Trending Topics and Most Searched sections, as well as Binance News, Research, and OTC. The trending lists had no accurate tag directly related to this debate over proof placement, so I’m not borrowing attention from BTC or ZEC trends. I also checked the Federal Reserve, SEC, ETF institutions, Strategy, exchange security, and official Ethereum sources. Farside’s October 19 ETH spot ETF data is still incomplete, so an automated aggregate should not be treated as zero actual inflows. Previous ETH articles covered block access-list fees, validator public-key registration, and the earlier break below $2,400; this article focuses only on proof availability and synchronization costs.

How has the market reacted so far? Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,401 when I wrote this, with a daily open of $2,407.51, an intraday low of $2,382.78, and a high of $2,443.70. Price is below the daily open and has just approached $2,400, but there is no evidence that this Draft drove the price action. First, watch whether price can reclaim $2,408, then $2,425 and $2,444. To the downside, watch $2,383; if that breaks, the next level is $2,354. If price holds above $2,425, I’ll revise my cautiously neutral view. If it breaks below $2,383 and the rebound is weak, I won’t treat $2,400 as reliable support. Platform quotes may differ from execution prices, so check again before trading.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and only consider a small spot long, using no more than 2% of my total capital. The trigger would be two consecutive 15-minute candles closing above $2,425, followed by a retest that holds $2,408 with normal order-book depth. The first target is $2,444, where I’d sell half; I’d look to $2,470 for the remainder. If a candle closes back below $2,408 after entry, I’d exit the entire position; the hard stop would be below $2,382. If price breaks below $2,383 before I enter, I’d cancel the plan and would not add against the trend. If the PR gets a new review, the ETF data is completed, or there is a sudden macroeconomic shift, I’d reassess before acting. If the trigger is not met, the plan is to stay in cash; that is not a realized gain.

Sources: EIPs PR #12549, the official EIP-8288 draft, Farside, and Kraken. #ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

📰 South Korea Delaying Crypto Tax for the Third Time? What Does a 2029 Start Mean for the Market?

South Korea is once again looking to delay its capital gains tax on cryptocurrency. This time, the proposal would push the start date back to 2029, but the Finance Ministry and exchanges still need to meet on October 20 to confirm the details. To be frank, this would be the third time South Korea has changed its crypto tax plans. Three postponements show just how hesitant policymakers are. For local exchanges and investors, it means policy uncertainty remains high.

Why does this news matter?
South Korea is a key global hub for cryptocurrency regulation, and each time the country backs off, market sentiment is affected. The underlying reason for this third postponement is that the South Korean government can't decide whether cryptocurrency should be treated as an investment or speculation. Taxing it as speculation could cause trading volume to plunge in the short term; treating it as an investment, meanwhile, raises fears that capital could flee. At its core, these three postponements reflect policymakers repeatedly testing the boundary between “investment vs. speculation.”

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, news of South Korea's delay is a short-term sentiment jolt. After the announcement, prices on local South Korean exchanges may initially spike and then pull back, while global market sentiment may also become more volatile. In the long run, however, this uncertainty is itself a source of pressure. For the industry as a whole, it means regulatory arbitrage will continue—for example, South Korean users may keep using exchanges in Vietnam or Thailand to avoid taxes until South Korea lays out a clear plan. A historical reference point is the market reaction when South Korea first proposed a crypto tax in 2018, which caused the KRW-to-BTC exchange rate to plunge by 40%.

💡 If South Korea suddenly announces that it will bring the tax forward, or the United States introduces a similar plan, the continuity of South Korea's policy would be disrupted, and this analytical framework would no longer apply. Put simply: the longer policy keeps wavering, the more likely an unexpected reversal becomes.

韩国又双叒叕要推迟加密货币资本利得税了。这次提议把起征时间往后挪到2029年，不过财政部和交易所之间还得在10月20号碰头确认。说实话，这已经不是韩国加密税第三次改计划了，三次搁置足以说明政策制定有多犹豫。对国内交易所和投资者来说，意味着政策不确定性还在高位。

为什么这条新闻重要？
韩国是全球加密货币监管的关键节点，但每次韩国放个鸽子，市场情绪都会受影响。这次第三次延期，根本原因在于韩国政府拿捏不准加密货币到底算投资还是投机。如果当成投机征税，短期内交易量会断崖式下跌；如果当投资，又担心资金流跑路。三次搁置，本质是政策制定者在“投资 vs 投机”的边界线上反复试探。

title: 🚀 ETH по $10 000, SOL по $500, LINK по $100: что должно произойти, чтобы увидеть такие цены?
subTitle:
Назвать красивую цифру легко. Гораздо интереснее понять, какого масштаба должен достичь проект, чтобы она имела смысл.
Моя тройка для долгосрочного наблюдения — Ethereum, Solana и Chainlink. Выбираю по применению, роли в инфраструктуре и возможности роста спроса на токен.
Горизонт — до конца 2030 года. Цифры ниже — мои условные бычьи сценарии, а не рассчитанная справедливая стоимость, прогноз аналитиков или обещание доходности.
🥇 Ethereum — ETH
Основная идея: использование Ethereum для финансовых приложений, стейблкоинов и токенизированных активов. Расширение JPM Coin на Ethereum — один из примеров такого применения.
Смелый сценарий: $8 000–10 000.
При условных 120 млн ETH в обращении это капитализация $960 млрд–1,2 трлн. Следовательно, речь о рынке огромного масштаба.
Что потребуется: устойчивый спрос на расчёты и обеспечение в ETH, развитие приложений и благоприятный рынок.
Что может помешать: конкуренция и ситуация, когда экосистема растёт, а экономическая выгода для самого ETH оказывается слабее ожиданий.
🥈 Solana — SOL
Идея: сеть для массовых приложений, торговли и платежей. Для долгосрочного сценария особенно важно, чтобы спрос сохранялся и вне очередной волны мемкоинов.
Смелый сценарий: $400–500.
При условном будущем обращении в 650 млн SOL это капитализация $260–325 млрд. Предложение к 2030 году может отличаться: это допущение для расчёта, а не прогноз эмиссии.
Что потребуется: рост устойчивой активности, надёжная работа сети и спрос на SOL, который успевает за увеличением предложения.
Что может помешать: снижение спекулятивной активности, конкуренция и технические проблемы.
🥉 Chainlink — LINK
Идея: инфраструктура, которая передаёт данные в блокчейны и помогает разным сетям взаимодействовать.
В экономической модели Chainlink предусмотрены оплата услуг и стейкинг в LINK, а также конвертация доходов в токен через Payment Abstraction.
Смелый сценарий: $70–100.
При полном предложении в 1 млрд LINK это $70–100 млрд полностью разводнённой оценки. Капитализация обращающихся монет будет зависеть от того, сколько токенов выйдет на рынок.
Что потребуется: масштабное платное использование сервисов и заметный спрос на LINK.
Что может помешать: внедрение технологии без сопоставимого роста спроса на токен, конкуренты и увеличение обращающегося предложения.
⚠️ А где максимально возможная цена?
Честного численного потолка нет. Назвать ETH по $20 000 или SOL по $1 000 можно, но без обоснования это будет просто фантазия.
Даже перечисленные сценарии могут не реализоваться. Каждый из этих активов способен оказаться существенно ниже сегодняшней цены — наличие работающего продукта не отменяет риск потерь.
Мой выбор для обсуждения: ETH — ставка на финансовую инфраструктуру, SOL — на массовое использование, LINK — на спрос на данные и связь между сетями.
Какой из трёх сценариев кажется вам наиболее убедительным, а какой — слишком смелым? 👇

translatedData.content:
ETH funds see $103.3 million in single-day outflows | Price reclaims $2,400 | I’ll wait for confirmation, not chase the bounce

My stance is cautious: the price moving back above $2,400 is a sign that the short-term decline may be stabilizing, not proof that institutional funds have returned. Farside’s updated summary of U.S. spot Ethereum funds for October 19 shows net outflows of $103.3 million, including $95.4 million from BlackRock’s ETHA, $6 million from Fidelity’s FETH, and $1.9 million from Grayscale’s ETHE. Unlike this morning, when only partial fund data was available, the complete table now shows ETHA’s larger outflow. We shouldn’t continue using the earlier provisional figure to characterize the market. This table is a third-party, fund-by-fund compilation and may still be revised later. I also wouldn’t equate net outflows directly with the amount of ETH sold on-chain.

Why is this data worth watching? Spot funds give traditional investors a way to hold ETH. When redemptions persist, the buffer of new buying thins, making rebounds more sensitive to trading flows. But subscriptions and redemptions, market-maker hedging, and spot execution don’t happen at the same time, so a single day’s fund flow can’t predict the next candlestick. ETH is also influenced by dollar interest rates, sentiment toward risk assets, and demand on the network itself. I don’t agree with interpreting one figure as “the price must fall,” or a move back above a round-number level as “institutions are rushing to buy.”

The market has already sent mixed signals. As of around noon Beijing time today, Kraken’s ETH/USD price was about $2,411, with an intraday low near $2,370 and a high near $2,415. In other words, the price has reclaimed the $2,400 level after falling below it, but has yet to clear resistance near the previous high. A Binance Square trending topic is #BitMineAdds12535ETH, but corporate accumulation and fund outflows involve different channels of capital. They don’t cancel each other out, nor do they prove that the same buyers are stepping in to absorb selling. Today, I’m paying more attention to whether $2,400 holds on a retest and whether subsequent fund data improves consistently, rather than chasing the price because of a headline about a single institution.

If I were trading, I wouldn’t chase a rally or open a short position. I’d stay in cash and observe for now. I’d consider a spot long only if ETH retests $2,400–$2,405 and then holds above that range, with an hourly close above $2,415. The initial position would be no more than 2% of my total capital, with no leverage. My first target would be $2,440; I’d take half off there and hold the rest toward $2,470. If the price falls below $2,385 after entry, I’d stop out and close the remaining position. Even if the stop isn’t hit, I’d abandon the long plan if the next round of fund data shows continued heavy outflows and the price loses $2,400 again. If there’s no confirmed retest or breakout, today will be a no-trade day. A plan shouldn’t be written up as if a trade has already been made.

Data sources: Farside Investors’ daily table of U.S. spot ETH funds and Kraken’s live ETH/USD market data. Observation time: around noon Beijing time on October 20. Please refer to the updated pages for the latest prices and fund data. #BitMineAdds12535ETH #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金单日流出1.033亿美元｜价格重返2400上方｜我只等确认不追反弹

我的态度偏谨慎：价格重新站到2400美元上方，是短线止跌的线索，不是机构资金已经回流的证据。Farside更新的10月19日美国现货以太坊基金汇总为净流出1.033亿美元，其中贝莱德ETHA流出9540万美元、富达FETH流出600万美元、灰度ETHE流出190万美元。与上午只看见部分基金数据时不同，现在完整表格已显示ETHA这笔更大的流出；不能继续用当时的暂估数给市场定性。这个表是第三方逐基金汇总，日后仍可能修订，我也不会把净流出直接说成链上抛售数量。

为什么这条数据值得看？现货基金给传统资金提供了持有ETH的入口。持续赎回时，新增买盘的缓冲变薄，反弹对交易盘更敏感；但申赎、做市对冲和现货执行有时间差，单日资金流不是下一根K线的预言。何况ETH还受美元利率、风险资产情绪及网络自身需求共同影响。把一个数字解释成“必跌”，和把价格站回整数关口解释成“机构抢筹”，我都不认同。

市场已经给出一组矛盾信号：截至北京时间今天中午，Kraken ETH/USD报价约2411美元，日内低点约2370、高点约2415；也就是价格从2400下方收复整数位，却尚未摆脱前高附近的阻力。币安广场热点里有#BitMineAdds12535ETH，但公司增持与基金净流出属于不同资金通道，不能相互抵消，也不能据此推断同一批买家正在承接。今天我更重视2400能否在回踩时守住，以及后续基金数据是否连续改善，而不是被单个机构标题带着追价。

如果是我自己交易，目前不追涨、不做空，先空仓观察。只有ETH回踩2400—2405美元后重新站稳，且一小时收盘高于2415，我才考虑现货试多，初始仓位不超过总资金的2%，不用杠杆；第一目标2440美元，到了先减半，余仓看2470。若入场后跌破2385，执行止损并平掉余仓；即便未触发止损，只要基金下一轮数据继续大幅流出、价格又失守2400，我也主动撤销多头计划。若始终没有回踩确认或突破确认，今天就是零交易，不能把计划写成已经成交。

The EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) is the virtual machine that executes Ethereum smart contracts. Every node executes the same contract code according to the same rules.
Once a contract is deployed, its bytecode is fixed and anyone can view it. Whether the source code is readable depends on whether the developer has verified it on a block explorer.
When a contract is called on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for each instruction it executes, paid using $ETH . Current: 2413.98.
Knowledge can help you avoid pitfalls, but it can’t replace position management.

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
Ethereum contracts are usually written in Solidity or Vyper, compiled into bytecode, and deployed on-chain, where the EVM executes the opcodes one by one.
Each EVM opcode has a fixed Gas cost. Operations such as writing to storage are much more expensive than ordinary computation.
When managing positions, one thing to pay particular attention to is checking the block explorer to see whether a contract’s source code has been verified before interacting with it. Be extra cautious with contracts whose source code isn’t public.

Just now, Google made its decision: Starting October 21, 2026, exchanges and software wallets holding locally regulated UAE licenses can run crypto ads on Google Ads. Those without licenses will still be unable to advertise.

- Scope: This rule applies to cryptocurrency exchanges and software wallets targeting users in the UAE, as well as CFDs and rolling spot forex.
- Accepted licenses: Exchanges/wallets may use licenses from the CMA, DFSA, FSRA, or VARA; CFDs/forex are limited to CMA, DFSA, and FSRA licenses. Previously, only VARA or FSRA multilateral trading facility licenses were accepted. CMA and DFSA have now been added, giving licensed businesses more options.
- Certification requirements: Advertisers must complete Google's certification process in their Google Ads account. All ad formats require certification. Once approved, the status will be “Eligible (Limited),” meaning ads can only run with restrictions.
- Still prohibited: Ads for ICOs, DeFi trading protocols, and crypto lending remain prohibited. Unlicensed projects cannot pass certification, and violations may result in a warning or even account suspension.
- Targeting considerations: The rule applies based on whether ads target UAE users, not where the company is registered. Licenses held by different entities under the same brand cannot be used interchangeably.

What this means for everyday users: Crypto ads appearing in UAE searches will generally be for platforms licensed and certified by Google. This may increase trust, but users should still verify platforms' credentials and watch out for counterfeit ads.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year. A steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t rely on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for; discipline is up to you. Don’t make your goal
“doubling your money this week.” Make it “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

📰 New U.S. Treasury DeFi rules are on the way—but what do they mean for stablecoins?

The Blockchain Association has just submitted comments to the U.S. Treasury, saying that the sections of the proposed GENIUS Act covering stablecoin issuance and transactions need to be clearer. In particular, the rules on how DeFi projects and foreign issuers will be regulated are currently somewhat vague. This mainly affects companies looking to offer stablecoin or DeFi services in the U.S., especially foreign companies.

Why does this matter?
At its core, this is about the U.S. trying to establish clear rules for the crypto market. The GENIUS Act was originally intended to pave the way for stablecoins used in cross-border payments, but DeFi projects and foreign issuers also fall under these rules, so everyone is watching closely to see how they’ll be defined. If the rules remain unclear, these companies could face compliance risks and may be reluctant to operate in the U.S. This reflects the U.S. approach to crypto regulation: encourage innovation while ensuring stability.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, this news is neutral in itself, but it could have indirect effects. If the rules are too strict, some DeFi projects and foreign companies may leave the U.S. market, potentially shifting capital flows, but it’s unlikely to directly push BTC or ETH prices up or down. Historically, markets often react negatively at first when regulations tighten, but if the changes ultimately help bring more order to the market, they could be positive in the long run.

Trading perspective
For now, this news is more likely to affect market sentiment and expectations around capital flows. It means regulatory developments will continue to keep the market on edge over the coming months. The outcome will depend on how the Treasury ultimately revises the rules. If the rules are clearer than they are now, that could benefit the stablecoin industry and indirectly improve sentiment across the crypto market.

📰 美国财政部DeFi新规要来了，到底对稳定币啥影响？

区块链行业协会刚给美国财政部提意见，说财政部想推的GENIUS法案里，关于稳定币发行和交易规则的部分需要更清楚。特别是DeFi项目和外国发行商怎么管的问题，现在说法有点模糊。这事儿主要影响那些想在美国搞稳定币、DeFi业务的公司，特别是那些外国公司。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这背后其实是美国想管好加密货币市场的游戏规则。GENIUS法案本来是给跨境支付用的稳定币开绿灯的，但DeFi和外国发行商也用这个规则，所以大家都很关心怎么界定。如果规则不清，这些公司就会面临合规风险，可能就不敢在美国搞业务了。这反映了美国在加密监管上的态度：既要鼓励创新，又要确保稳定。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH来说，这条新闻本身偏中性，但影响是间接的。如果规则太严，可能会让部分DeFi项目和国外公司离开美国市场，资金流向可能会变，但很难直接推高或压低BTC/ETH价格。历史上看，监管收紧时市场情绪往往先跌，但如果最终能促进市场规范化，长期看可能是好事。

操作思路
目前看，这条新闻更多是影响市场情绪和资金流向预期。它意味着未来几个月，监管动向会继续牵动市场神经。但具体怎么走，还得看财政部最终怎么改规则。如果规则比现在更清晰，对稳定币行业可能是利好，间接利好整个加密市场情绪。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candle you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the chat is yelling “Go!”, and you impulsively chase in—only to end up buying at
the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested want you to chase in and take
off their hands. Chasing a move after a sharp, high-volume rally is essentially providing liquidity to those who got in earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback happens on declining volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself a costly lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your capital back.

Whale loses $469,000 in hours on Hyperliquid, yet re-enters with $16M ETH short bet

An unknown trader on Hyperliquid realized about $469,000 in losses before fees as an overnight Ethereum rebound forced the closure of nearly $19.8 million in eth short exposure.

By the afternoon of Oct. 19, the wallet was adding to its bet against eth again. Four new short orders between 13:56 and 14:04 UTC on Oct. 19 added about 1,126.2 $ETH, worth roughly $2.7 million at execution.

By the 16:00 UTC account check, the wallet was short about 6,789.3 $ETH, with the position valued near $16.2 million.
At 16:00 UTC on Oct. 19, that short used cross margin with leverage set to 25x. Hyperliquid estimated its liquidation price at about $2,434.67, while the venue's eth mid-price immediately after the account check was about $2,393.05.

The trigger depends on mark price, which incorporates external exchange prices and Hyperliquid's order book. Funding payments and cross-margin account conditions can change the displayed liquidation estimate.

Hyperliquid's public fill data records 8,162.845 eth of forced short closures across 632 execution fills. Those executions belonged to four partial liquidation groups between 23:27 UTC on Oct. 18 and 07:34 UTC on Oct. 19.

The $19.8 million total measures the eth exposure closed at execution prices, while the roughly $469,000 realized loss is the trading result on those closures before fees and funding. It excludes any unrealized gain or loss on the short that remained open, so neither figure describes the account's complete trading result.

The wallet received 1,252,457.80 $USDC at 15:19 UTC on Oct. 18, and opening short sales later that day traded near $2,366. The subsequent forced closures executed between about $2,409 and $2,445 as eth rebounded, buying back exposure at higher prices than those entries.

Blockchain Association submits comments on implementation rules for Section 3 of the GENIUS Act, clarifying the boundaries of stablecoin business

The Blockchain Association recently submitted comments to the U.S. Treasury Department on Section 3 of the GENIUS Act, which has been passed, making three key requests:

1. Draw clear lines of responsibility — Regulators may oversee stablecoin issuers, but should not bring the entire on-chain ecosystem under their jurisdiction.
2. Exclude non-core participants — Self-custody wallet software, validator nodes, and businesses that trade only their own assets should not be categorically classified as “digital asset service providers.”
3. Clarify criminal liability — Parties should be held criminally liable only when they “knowingly and materially assist,” avoiding undue pressure on technology developers and infrastructure providers.

Why is this rule worth watching?  
- If the regulatory scope is too broad, developers and infrastructure providers will face steep compliance costs and may be forced to abandon the U.S. market.  
- If the boundaries are clearly defined, regulated entities will have clear guidance and be able to scale up their stablecoin operations, creating long-term benefits for the stablecoin ecosystem and on-chain payments.  

In the short term, the market’s reaction to these comments has been relatively neutral, with attention focused mainly on how stringent the Treasury Department’s final rules will be. If the rules are relatively lenient, they could attract more projects to the United States; if they are stricter, projects may relocate.

Where do you think the appropriate limits of regulation should be?  

#美国区块链协会提交GENIUS法案意见 #ETH #BTC

content:
美国区块链协会提交《GENIUS法案》第3条实施细则意见，明确稳定币业务边界

美国区块链协会（Blockchain Association）近日向美国财政部提交意见，针对已通过的《GENIUS法案》第3条提出三点核心诉求：

1. 划清责任边界——监管机构可以对稳定币发行方进行监管，但不应把整个链上生态全部纳入管辖。  
2. 排除非核心主体——自托管钱包软件、验证者节点以及仅交易自有资产的企业，不应被“一刀切”认定为“数字资产服务商”。  
3. 细化刑事责任——只有在当事方“实际知情并提供实质帮助”的情况下，才应承担刑事责任，避免对技术开发者和基础设施提供者造成不当压力。

为什么这条规则值得关注？  
- 若监管边界过宽，开发者和基础设施提供商将面临高额合规成本，可能被迫放弃美国市场。  
- 若边界划得清晰，合规机构有明确指引，能够大规模开展稳定币业务，对稳定币生态和链上支付形成长期利好。  

短期来看，市场对该意见的反应相对中性，主要关注财政部最终细则的落地力度。后续若规则偏向宽松，可能吸引更多项目落地美国；若趋严，则可能出现项目迁移的风险。

你认为监管应当到哪一层才合适？

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum (ETH) Market: Positive Institutional News, but Short-Term Technicals Remain Weak

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of 10:00 a.m. Beijing time on October 20, the spot price of Ethereum was $2,392, down approximately 0.97% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH first declined and then stabilized over the past five hours. The price gradually fell from $2,407 to a low of $2,372, then stabilized around $2,388 before rebounding to $2,411 on the latest candle.

The core tension facing Ethereum recently lies in the tug-of-war between positive institutional news and outflows from ETFs. On the positive side, JPMorgan expanded its dollar deposit token, JPMD, to the Ethereum mainnet on October 19, enabling institutional clients to settle transactions almost instantly around the clock. The move deepens Wall Street’s ties to Ethereum; JPMD was previously deployed on Coinbase’s Base network. In addition, Germany’s Sparkassen banking group has launched retail crypto trading services, further broadening Ethereum’s user base.

Corporate accumulation is also worth noting. BitMine purchased an additional 12,535 ETH, bringing corporate treasury holdings to more than 6.04 million ETH. However, spot Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of approximately $320 million last week, marking three consecutive weeks of net outflows and bringing cumulative outflows close to $1 billion—a sustained source of institutional selling pressure.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

Hourly technical indicators suggest that Ethereum’s short-term technical picture is weak, although momentum is improving.

As for moving averages, the 7-hour MA stands at $2,404, the 25-hour MA at $2,413, and the 99-hour MA at $2,417. The three moving averages are in a bearish alignment, with the price below all of them, indicating a weak short-term trend. However, the latest candle has climbed back above the 7-hour MA, suggesting that short-term rebound momentum is building.

The MACD indicator shows a DIF of -1.61, a signal line of -1.44, and a histogram reading of -0.17. MACD remains below the zero line, but the histogram has narrowed sharply from -0.99 to -0.17, indicating a significant decline in bearish momentum and the possibility of a short-term bullish crossover.

The RSI indicators have rebounded noticeably. The 6-period RSI climbed rapidly from 39.95 to 62.25, the 12-period RSI rose to 53.73, and the 24-period RSI recovered to 50.93. The short-term RSI has entered relatively strong territory, indicating growing buying pressure.

The KDJ indicator is showing strong signals. The K line has risen to 65.03, the D line to 53.53, and the J line has surged to 88.03. The three lines are diverging upward, and the J line is approaching overbought territory. This indicates strong short-term bullish momentum, though the risk of a pullback should also be watched.

For the Bollinger Bands, the upper band is at $2,434, the middle band at $2,409, and the lower band at $2,384. The price has rebounded from near the lower band to above the middle band, while the bands are narrowing, suggesting a possible directional breakout in the short term.

Overall, eight of the 15 indicators are signaling a long position, six are signaling a short position, and one is neutral. Although the combined indicator still signals a short position, short-term momentum is beginning to tilt bullish.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Sentiment in the Ethereum market is currently mixed. Fundamentally, JPMorgan’s deployment of JPM Coin on the Ethereum mainnet is a milestone, signaling growing recognition among traditional financial institutions of Ethereum as a settlement layer. Stablecoin payment volume reached $482 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, up 45% year over year, and Ethereum’s position as a leading chain for stablecoins remains firmly established.

However, Ethereum’s share of stablecoin settlements fell to approximately 15% in the third quarter, as it faces intense competition from alternative chains such as TRON. TRON’s stablecoin market capitalization grew by $554.9 million over the past seven days, underscoring the competitive pressure.

From a capital-flow perspective, approximately $1 billion in ETF outflows over three consecutive weeks reflects growing caution among institutional investors at current price levels. However, continued corporate treasury accumulation and deep involvement from institutions such as JPMorgan provide firm support for Ethereum’s medium- to long-term value.

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：机构利好频传但短期技术面偏弱

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二十日上午十点，以太坊现货价格报两千三百九十二美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点九七。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内呈现出先跌后稳的走势。价格从两千四百零七美元逐步回落，最低触及两千三百七十二美元，随后在两千三百八十八美元附近企稳，并在最新一根K线中反弹至两千四百一十一美元。

以太坊近期面临的核心矛盾在于机构利好消息与ETF资金流出之间的博弈。积极方面，摩根大通于十月十九日将其美元存款代币JPMD扩展至以太坊主网，使机构客户能够实现全天候近即时结算。这一举措深化了华尔街与以太坊的联系，此前JPMD已在Coinbase的Base网络上部署。此外，德国Sparkassen银行也推出了零售加密交易服务，进一步拓宽了以太坊的用户基础。

企业层面的增持同样值得关注。BitMine新购入一万两千五百三十五枚ETH，使企业级国库持仓突破六百零四万枚ETH。然而，现货以太坊ETF上周净流出约三亿两千万美元，已连续三周录得净流出，累计流出规模接近十亿美元，形成了持续的机构抛压。

二、技术指标解读

从小时级别技术指标来看，以太坊的技术面呈现出短期偏弱但动能改善的特征。

均线系统方面，七小时均线报两千四百零四美元，二十五小时均线报两千四百一十三美元，九十九小时均线报两千四百一十七美元。三条均线呈空头排列，价格运行在所有均线下方，显示短期趋势偏弱。不过，最新一根K线已回升至七小时均线上方，暗示短期反弹动能正在积蓄。

MACD指标显示，DIF线为负一点六一，信号线为负一点四四，柱状图为负零点一七。MACD仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图从负零点九九大幅收窄至负零点一七，空头动能显著衰减，短期有望出现金叉信号。

RSI指标明显回暖。六周期RSI从三十九点九五快速攀升至六十二点二五，十二周期RSI升至五十三点七三，二十四周期RSI回升至五十点九三。短期RSI已进入偏强区域，显示买盘力量正在增强。

KDJ指标呈现强势信号。K线升至六十五点零三，D线升至五十三点五三，J线大幅攀升至八十八点零三。三线向上发散，J线接近超买区域，表明短期多头力量较强，但也需警惕回调风险。

布林带方面，上轨报两千四百三十四美元，中轨报两千四百零九美元，下轨报两千三百八十四美元。价格从下轨附近反弹至中轨上方，布林带开口收窄，暗示短期内可能出现方向性突破。

综合来看，十五个因子中有八个发出做多信号，六个发出做空信号，一个中性信号。虽然综合指标仍给出做空信号，但短期动能正在向多头倾斜。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪呈现分化格局。从基本面来看，摩根大通将JPM Coin部署到以太坊主网是一个里程碑式的事件，标志着传统金融机构对以太坊作为结算层的认可正在加深。稳定币支付量在二零二六年前三季度达到四千八百二十亿美元，同比增长百分之四十五，以太坊作为稳定币主要承载链的地位依然稳固。

然而，以太坊的稳定币结算份额在第三季度下降至约百分之十五，面临来自TRON等替代链的激烈竞争。TRON在过去七天内实现了五亿五千四百九十万美元的稳定币市值增长，竞争压力不容忽视。

从资金面来看，ETF连续三周流出约十亿美元，反映出机构投资者在当前价位趋于谨慎。不过，企业国库的持续增持和摩根大通等机构的深度参与，为以太坊的中长期价值提供了坚实支撑。

短期来看，以太坊在两千三百八十美元至两千四百三十五美元区间内整理的可能性较大。若能放量突破两千四百三十五美元，则有望挑战两千四百五十美元以上的阻力位。反之，若跌破两千三百八十美元支撑，可能进一步下探两千三百五十美元。

translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position look at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Take note: this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you start stubbornly holding a position, you automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The cure is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then follow through when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from the act of holding, and you’ll be able to see clearly.
