📰 Just how convenient are stablecoins for cross-border payments? BIS report lays bare the reality

A new report from the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) says stablecoins can indeed speed up cross-border payments. For example, transferring money over the Ethereum or Solana network avoids routing payments through SWIFT as in the past, and can save on fees paid to traditional banks. But the report also points out a sobering fact: stablecoin liquidity is actually limited, and may not be enough to meet large-scale demand at any moment. For the crypto market, it’s like discovering a powerful move that you can’t use at full strength.

Why does this news matter?

This wasn’t a small-scale survey by the BIS. It made a direct comparison between traditional banks, fintech companies, and stablecoins. The data shows that stablecoins do have an edge in cross-border payment speed—for instance, the exchange rate of dollar-pegged stablecoins can keep pace with the interbank foreign exchange market rate. That’s a real improvement. But the key point is that the BIS also emphasized the liquidity bottleneck: if many people try to redeem their stablecoins for cash at the same time, they may find there simply isn’t enough cash available.

What does this mean? Put simply, cross-border stablecoin payments are currently more like an “express lane with restrictions”: suitable for routine, smaller transactions, but potentially prone to bottlenecks when sudden, large-scale demand hits. For regulators, this raises a new question: how do you oversee something that can both move fast and “issue money” without letting it run amok?

Market impact

In the short term, the BIS’s endorsement means the stablecoin sector will continue to attract investor attention. In the long run, however, liquidity constraints will limit the sector’s growth potential. The main impact on BTC and ETH will be in terms of capital flows: money may continue to flow into dollar stablecoins, while large cross-border transactions may be more likely to favor digital assets with reserve value, such as BTC and ETH.

A similar event from the past? Central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) are the closest point of comparison. CBDCs also face technical and regulatory challenges in cross-border circulation, but this BIS report brings the issue to light early for privately issued stablecoins, serving as a wake-up call for the entire industry.

💡 The BIS report won’t directly change the short-term trajectory of stablecoins, but it will push the industry to pay more attention to liquidity risk management. If a large-scale stablecoin redemption run occurs in the future, this report could become an important basis for regulatory intervention.

BIS这次不是小范围调研，是实打实对比了传统银行、Fintech公司和稳定币的表现。数据表明，稳定币在跨境支付速度上确实占优——比如美元稳定币汇率能追上银行间外汇市场价，这个进步不是闹着玩的。但关键在于，BIS也强调了流动性瓶颈：如果同时有很多人想提现稳定币换成现金，可能会发现根本不够用。

ETH | Geth Adds Draft Transaction Inclusion Lists | Meaningful for Censorship Resistance, but Price Has Yet to React

My view is to respect protocol progress while remaining cautious in my trading. On October 19, an implementation pull request for EIP-7805 transaction inclusion lists appeared in the official go-ethereum repository. Its status is explicitly Draft; it has not been merged, let alone deployed. The EIP website itself also labels it Draft. This design is not about “immediate speed gains” or “an instant drop in gas fees.” Rather, as block building becomes increasingly centralized, it would allow a group of validators to propose transactions that should be included, and voters to check whether a block meets the requirements—strengthening the assurance that ordinary transactions will be included in a timely manner. It involves coordination between the execution and consensus layers, so a code draft should not be mistaken for an announcement that it is live on mainnet.

Why does this matter for ETH? If it eventually passes multi-client implementation, testnet validation, audits, and hard-fork coordination, more reliable transaction inclusion could strengthen trust in Ethereum as an open settlement layer. That matters for long-term use cases, but it will not automatically generate spot buying on the day. The proposal also notes risks related to network propagation, the timing of builders receiving lists, and consensus liveness. These are precisely the areas developers still need to validate. What matters to track is review feedback, whether other clients follow suit, test results, and formal upgrade plans—not seeing the words “censorship resistance” and assuming capital has already flowed in.

The market reaction needs to be assessed separately. At around 11 a.m. Beijing time, I checked ETH/USD on Kraken: the price was about $2,405, with an intraday low of around $2,370 and a high of around $2,444. It was basically in the middle of the day’s range, with insufficient evidence to say this draft triggered a sustained rally. Binance Square’s trending topics are currently focused mainly on chip stocks, treasury sizes, regulatory meeting minutes, and other subjects; I haven’t seen a trending topic directly related to EIP-7805, so I’m using only #ETH for this post and not attaching unrelated tags. Farside’s October 19 ETH ETF table still has blank entries in the major-fund columns, so a provisional total should not be misrepresented as a complete picture of institutional flows.

If I were trading it myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long, with no leverage. The entry trigger would be ETH/USD moving back above $2,444 and then holding $2,435 on a retest in at least one subsequent 30-minute candle. If that happens, I would use no more than 3% of account equity to open a position. The first target is $2,480; there I would close half and move the protective stop on the remainder up to around the entry price. The second target is $2,510, where I would close the remaining position in stages. I would set the initial stop below $2,390. If, after entry, the price falls back below $2,435 and fails to recover by the close of the next 30-minute candle, I would exit early. If the price breaks below $2,370 first, I would cancel this bullish plan outright. The key invalidation conditions are the draft failing to pass testing in a timely manner, or a failed price breakout. If either occurs, I would not use “long-term technological progress” to justify short-term losses.

The technical development is worth following over the long term, but trading triggers still need confirmation from price and capital flows. If the conditions aren’t there, I’ll stay out. Compared with “missing the move,” I’m more concerned about presenting a design that hasn’t been implemented as if its benefits have already been realized. #ETH

ETH｜Geth新增交易纳入清单草案｜抗审查有意义，价格暂不抢跑

我的态度是尊重协议进展，但交易上仍偏谨慎。10月19日，go-ethereum官方仓库出现EIP-7805交易纳入清单的实现拉取请求，状态明确是Draft，尚未合并，更没有部署。EIP官网本身也标着Draft。这项设计想解决的不是“立刻提速”或“Gas马上降低”，而是当区块构建越来越集中时，让一组验证者提出应被纳入的交易，并让投票者检查区块是否满足条件，从而增强普通交易被及时打包的保障。它牵涉执行层与共识层配合，不能把一份代码草稿当成主网生效公告。

为什么这与ETH相关？若未来经过多客户端实现、测试网验证、审计和硬分叉协调，交易纳入的可靠性可能改善以太坊作为开放结算层的可信度；这对长期使用场景有意义，却不会自动产生当日现货买盘。相反，提案也写到网络传播、构建者收到清单的时序和共识活性风险，这些边界正是开发者仍需验证的地方。要跟踪的是评审意见、其他客户端是否跟进、测试结果和正式升级安排，而不是看见“抗审查”三个字就假设资金已经进场。

市场反应需要分开看。我在北京时间约11点查看Kraken ETH/USD，价格约2405美元，当日低点约2370、高点约2444，基本在日内区间中部，没有足够证据说这份草案引发了持续上涨。币安广场热榜目前主要讨论芯片股、金库规模、监管纪要等，未见直接对应EIP-7805的上升话题，所以这篇只用#ETH，不蹭不相干标签。Farside的10月19日ETH ETF表仍有主力基金栏位空缺，也不能把暂列合计误说成完整机构资金流向。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓试多，不用杠杆。入场触发是ETH/USD重新站上2444美元，并在随后至少一根30分钟K线回踩守住2435美元；届时最多用账户权益3%建仓。第一目标2480美元，触及减仓一半并把余仓保护位抬到入场附近；第二目标2510美元，剩余仓位分批平仓。初始止损设在2390美元下方，若入场后重新跌破2435且无法在下一根30分钟K线收回，也提前退出；若价格先跌破2370美元，直接取消这套偏多计划。这里的关键推翻条件是草案迟迟无法通过测试、或价格突破失败；两者任何一个出现，我都不会继续拿“长期技术进步”替短线亏损辩护。

技术建设值得长期跟踪，交易触发仍要由价格和资金确认。没有条件就空仓，和“错过行情”相比，我更在意不把尚未落地的设计写成已经兑现的利好。#ETH

🐋 Beyond tracking the money, you should understand this too: transaction finality
Ethereum’s proof-of-stake system uses the Casper FFG mechanism. Each epoch contains 32 slots and lasts about 6.4 minutes.
Probabilistic finality is like a stack of paper that keeps getting taller: the more sheets piled on top, the harder it is to pull out the one at the bottom. Deterministic finality, on the other hand, is like a signed contract—once it’s signed, you can’t take it back.
On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  serves as a guarantee of finality: overturning a finalized block would mean losing a substantial amount of stake.
Knowledge can help you avoid pitfalls, but it can’t replace risk management.

#ETH

以太坊权益证明采用 Casper FFG 机制，每个 epoch 包含 32 个时隙（slot），约 6.4 分钟。
概率最终性好比越叠越高的一摞纸，上面压得越多，想抽出底下那张就越难；确定性最终性则像盖了章的合同，盖章后就不能反悔。
在以太坊上，质押的 $ETH 就是最终性的担保：推翻已最终确定的区块要损失大量质押。

Why does the same transfer sometimes cost just a few cents, but other times much more?
Definition: When a transfer fails, the Gas already consumed is usually not refunded, since validators have already done the computation.
The logic behind it: Layer 2 batches many transactions together before submitting them to the Ethereum mainnet, so the cost per transaction is usually much lower when spread across them.
$ETH  is the native currency used to pay Gas for settlement on the Ethereum mainnet.
Knowledge can help you avoid pitfalls, but it can't replace position management.

#ETH

$ETH 是以太坊主网结算 Gas 的原生币。

doesn't matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand shakes as you go to stop out, tell yourself
this: It's an entry ticket, not a verdict.

BitMine Immersion Technologies announced on October 19 that it had purchased another 12,535 ETH over the past week, bringing its holdings to 6,041,481 ETH as of October 18. At the reference price at the time of about $2,365, this position was worth approximately $14.3 billion, or about 4.9% of the 122.1 million ETH in circulation.

The company says it has completed about 99% of the path toward its “Alchemy of 5%” goal, and said it will end this round of ongoing purchases once it reaches the target. Since launching its treasury strategy on June 30, 2025, BitMine has continued buying weekly. Its $ETH holdings are reportedly the largest Ethereum treasury held by any crypto treasury worldwide. Its total crypto assets, cash, securities, and other holdings amount to about $15.1 billion.

About 5.067 million ETH (approximately 84%) has been staked through its MAVAN platform and partners. At current levels, estimated annualized staking revenue is about $309 million. Chairman Tom Lee attributed recent market pressure to geopolitical factors, bond yields, and declining risk appetite related to AI, and said the pullback offered a better risk-reward window. The market value of its holdings fluctuates with prices, and the plan may also be adjusted.
